steps.title: Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Grow neural stem cells (Cor3–1) in Complete media supplemented with necessary components including DMEM/HAM’S-F12, glucose, MEM-NEAA, penicillin, streptomycin, BSA, β-Mercapto-ethanol, B-27, and N2.

steps.title: Medium Preparation
steps.instruction: Before changing the medium or passaging the cells, add EGF, FGF, and Laminin to the required volume of Complete media.

steps.title: Neuronal Differentiation - Priming
steps.instruction: 24 hours after seeding, transfer the cells to priming medium (Euromed-N) supplemented with B-27 without vitamin A, N2, and FGF for 3 days.

steps.title: Neuronal Differentiation - Maturation
steps.instruction: After priming, transfer the cells to differentiation medium (1:3 ratio DMEM/HAM’S-F12:Neurobasal) supplemented with B-27 without vitamin A, N2, FGF, BDNF, and Laminin for 3 days.

steps.title: Medium Change
steps.instruction: Change the differentiation medium every 3 days, reducing FGF concentration by half until it reaches zero, while maintaining BDNF at 30 ng/ml.

steps.title: Transduction of CRE Recombinase
steps.instruction: Transduce neural stem cells (Floxed-Huwe1-RYFP) with adenovirus CMV-CRE at a MOI of 100, using empty adenovirus as a control.

steps.title: P19 Cell Maintenance
steps.instruction: Maintain P19 cells in MEM-α supplemented with FBS, penicillin, and streptomycin.

steps.title: P19 Cell Differentiation
steps.instruction: Transfer P19 cells to Neurobasal medium supplemented with penicillin/streptomycin, B-27 without vitamin A, GlutaMAX, and Laminin for differentiation.

steps.title: Transfection of P19 Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect P19 cells at 80% confluence with Lipofectamine 2000 using a 1:2 ratio of DNA to Lipofectamine.

steps.title: RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from cells using the RNeasy kit.

steps.title: cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize template cDNAs using the QuantiTect Reverse Transcription Kit.

steps.title: qRT-PCR
steps.instruction: Perform quantitative Real-Time PCR using QuantiFast SYBR Green Master Mix in a Lightcycler 480 PCR system, normalizing to the housekeeping gene EiF1α.

steps.title: Western Blotting
steps.instruction: Prepare total cell lysates using RIPA buffer, determine protein concentration, and perform SDS-PAGE followed by transfer to nitrocellulose membranes for immunoblotting.

steps.title: Cellular Fractionation
steps.instruction: Seed Cor3–1 and P19 cells, wash, and fractionate cells using E1 and E2 buffers to obtain cytoplasmic and nuclear fractions.

steps.title: Agarose-TUBEs Pull Down
steps.instruction: Use Agarose-TUBEs to pull down ubiquitylated proteins from cytoplasmic and chromatin fractions, followed by washing and elution for analysis.

steps.title: Ethics Approval
steps.instruction: Ensure that the use of human specimens is approved by the Ethics Reviewing Board of the University Hospital of Liege.

steps.title: Tissue Selection
steps.instruction: Obtain lung postmortem biopsy specimens from four COVID-19 patients and four non-COVID-19 controls, ensuring they are matched for age and sex.

steps.title: Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Formalin-fix and paraffin-embed the selected lung tissues, then cut serial sections of 4 µm thickness for histological and immunofluorescence examination.

steps.title: H&E Staining
steps.instruction: Stain the tissue sections with H&E and digitize the whole slides using a Pannoramic 250 Flash III Scanner.

steps.title: Antigen Retrieval
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize and rehydrate the tissue sections, then boil them in 10-mM sodium carbonate buffer for 20 minutes for antigen retrieval.

steps.title: Permeabilization
steps.instruction: Permeabilize the lung sections using PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100.

steps.title: Blocking
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples with a blocking buffer (PBS with 2% BSA and 2% donkey serum) for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Stain the samples with rabbit anti-human antibodies against citrullinated histone H3 and goat anti-human antibodies against MPO in blocking buffer for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Wash the samples with PBS, then incubate with secondary donkey anti-rabbit IgG and donkey anti-goat IgG antibodies conjugated with fluorescent dyes in blocking buffer containing DAPI for 2 hours in the dark.

steps.title: Mounting Samples
steps.instruction: Mount the stained samples on glass slides using ProLong Antifade reagent and store them at room temperature in the dark overnight.

steps.title: Fluorescence Microscopy
steps.instruction: Analyze all samples using fluorescence microscopy with standard filter sets and acquire images on a Zeiss LSM 880 Airyscan Elyra S.1. confocal microscope.

steps.title: NET Volume Quantification
steps.instruction: Quantify the volume of NETs in lung tissue by analyzing six fields per patient using Imaris software for three-dimensional reconstruction.

steps.title: Scanning for NET Areas
steps.instruction: Scan entire lung sections using the Nanozoomer 2.0-HT system and manually screen for areas rich in structures staining double positive for Cit-H3 and MPO.

steps.title: Statistical Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform statistical analysis on the data using a nonparametric Mann–Whitney U test to determine significance.

steps.title: Germinate seeds
steps.instruction: Germinate four-week-old tomato seeds in vermiculite under controlled growth chamber conditions with a 16/8h light/dark cycle, temperature of 24/18 °C, light intensity of 200 μmol m–2 s–1, and 60% relative humidity.

steps.title: Irrigate seedlings
steps.instruction: Irrigate the seedlings twice a week with distilled water for the first three weeks.

steps.title: Apply nutrient solutions
steps.instruction: Irrigate seedlings with Hoagland solution for control plants or with modified Hoagland solutions lacking nitrogen for treatment groups, adding K2SO4 and CaSO4 to compensate for nutrient deficiencies.

steps.title: Prepare PA biosynthesis inhibitors
steps.instruction: Dissolve DFMA and DFMO in water to create an inhibitor solution containing 2mM DFMA and 5mM DFMO.

steps.title: Treat plants with inhibitors
steps.instruction: Apply the inhibitor solution directly to each pot during the week prior to Pst inoculation.

steps.title: Foliar spray with Put
steps.instruction: Treat 4-week-old plants with 0.5mM Put or mock solution using foliar sprays applied 48 hours before Pst infection.

steps.title: Inoculate plants with Pst
steps.instruction: Prepare a bacterial suspension of Pst at 5×10^5 cfu ml–1 and inoculate the third and fourth leaves by dipping them into the suspension.

steps.title: Score disease rate
steps.instruction: Assess the disease rate at 72 hours post-inoculation by determining the percentage of dark-brown spots on the leaf surface.

steps.title: Collect leaf samples for analysis
steps.instruction: Collect leaf samples at 3, 24, and 48 hours post-inoculation for molecular and hormonal analyses.

steps.title: Measure biomass
steps.instruction: Dry collected tomato plant tissues at 65 ºC for 2 days and weigh to determine dry weight as biomass.

steps.title: Measure chlorophyll content
steps.instruction: Use a chlorophyll meter to measure the chlorophyll level of leaves from 4-week-old tomato plants, taking three measurements per leaf.

steps.title: Determine photosynthetic rate
steps.instruction: Utilize an LCpro+ portable infrared gas analyser to measure the net photosynthetic rate on three mature leaves from each of the 10 replicate plants.

steps.title: Perform DAB staining
steps.instruction: Collect leaf samples for DAB staining at 3, 24, and 48 hours post-inoculation, and process them for quantification of staining intensities.

steps.title: Extract RNA for qRT-PCR
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from leaf tissue samples collected at 3 and 48 hours post-inoculation using the E.Z.N.A. Plant RNA Kit.

steps.title: Analyze stomatal apertures
steps.instruction: Inoculate the third and fourth leaves with Pst, prepare casts using dental resin, and analyze stomatal apertures using microscopy.

steps.title: Prepare media
steps.instruction: Prepare L broth (LB) and T broth (TB) by mixing the appropriate components. Add ampicillin and arabinose to the media at final concentrations of 100 µg/ml and 0.02% (wt/vol), respectively.

steps.title: Replace fliG gene
steps.instruction: Use the λ Red homologous recombination system to replace the fliG gene on the chromosome with a pHluorin(M153R)-fliG allele.

steps.title: Grow Salmonella cells
steps.instruction: Inoculate Salmonella cells in 5 ml of LB and grow with shaking at 30°C until the optical density at 600 nm (OD600) reaches approximately 1.0.

steps.title: Wash cells
steps.instruction: Perform low-speed centrifugation to pellet the cells, then wash the cell pellet twice with motility buffer (10 mM potassium phosphate, 0.1 mM EDTA, pH 7.0).

steps.title: Resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed cell pellets in motility buffer and incubate at 30°C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Centrifuge cultures
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cultures again to separate the cell pellets from the culture supernatants.

steps.title: Prepare samples for SDS-PAGE
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellets in SDS loading buffer. Precipitate proteins from the culture supernatants using 10% trichloroacetic acid, then suspend in Tris-SDS loading buffer and heat at 95°C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Perform SDS-PAGE
steps.instruction: Run the samples on an SDS-PAGE gel and perform immunoblotting using polyclonal anti-FlgD and anti-FliC antibodies.

steps.title: Purify pHluorin(M153R)
steps.instruction: Purify pHluorin(M153R) from the soluble fractions of BL21(DE3)pLysS carrying pYVM007.

steps.title: Purify pHluorin(M153R)-FliG
steps.instruction: Purify pHluorin(M153R)-FliG-His using nickel-nitrilotriacetic acid (Ni-NTA) affinity chromatography from the soluble fractions of BL21(DE3)pLysS carrying pYVM013.

steps.title: Set up fluorescence microscopy
steps.instruction: Prepare a custom-built fluorescence microscope system with the appropriate optical components and excitation filters for observing Salmonella cells expressing pHluorin(M153R) variants.

steps.title: Capture fluorescence images
steps.instruction: Capture fluorescence images of Salmonella cells expressing pHluorin(M153R) using the EMCCD camera, ensuring to switch between excitation wavelengths.

steps.title: Determine cytoplasmic pH
steps.instruction: Analyze the captured fluorescence images to determine the bulk and local cytoplasmic pH using the ratio of fluorescence intensities at 410 nm and 470 nm.

steps.title: Prepare cryo-EM samples
steps.instruction: Prepare hook-basal bodies (HBBs) from Salmonella strains and apply a 3-μl solution onto a glow-discharged holey carbon grid.

steps.title: Collect cryo-EM images
steps.instruction: Quick-freeze the grids in liquid ethane and collect cryo-EM images using the Titan Krios electron microscope.

steps.title: Expand Astrocytes
steps.instruction: Obtain primary human astrocytes and expand them in Human Astrocyte Media supplemented with fetal bovine serum, penicillin-streptomycin, and Astrocyte Growth Supplement.

steps.title: Culture Astrocytes
steps.instruction: Culture astrocytes in a 50:50 mix of F10:MEMα media supplemented with 10% FBS and 1% penicillin-streptomycin.

steps.title: Treat Astrocytes with Antibody
steps.instruction: Treat astrocytes with 11 μg/ml of IGF1R-specific monoclonal antibody MAB391 for 24 hours to reduce IGF1R levels.

steps.title: Wash and Culture Astrocytes
steps.instruction: After 24 hours, wash the astrocytes with 1× PBS and culture them for an additional 72 hours in fresh F10:MEMα media.

steps.title: Grow LUHMES Cells
steps.instruction: Grow LUHMES cells in proliferation medium consisting of DMEM/F12 GlutaMAX™, N2 supplement, and 40 ng/ml recombinant FGF.

steps.title: Differentiate LUHMES Cells
steps.instruction: When LUHMES cells reach 50-60% confluence, replace the media with differentiation media containing DMEM/F12 GlutaMAX™, N2 supplement, and 1 μg/ml tetracycline.

steps.title: Replate LUHMES Cells
steps.instruction: After two days of differentiation, trypsinize LUHMES cells and replate them onto appropriate plates for an additional three days.

steps.title: Transduce GFP LUHMES
steps.instruction: Transduce low passage proliferating LUHMES with GFP-expressing lentiviral particles for 24 hours, then replace media with fresh proliferation media.

steps.title: Co-culture Astrocytes and LUHMES
steps.instruction: Seed astrocytes onto fibronectin-coated 24-well plates at a density of 30,000 cells/well, and add differentiation media to a separate flask of LUHMES.

steps.title: Replate LUHMES onto Astrocytes
steps.instruction: Two days later, replate LUHMES cells onto the astrocytes at a density of 7,500 cells/well and maintain co-cultures in differentiation media for 24 hours.

steps.title: Treat Co-cultures with H2O2
steps.instruction: After 72 hours of co-culture, treat the cells with 50 μM H2O2 for 2 hours.

steps.title: Prepare Astrocyte Lysates
steps.instruction: Remove the medium, wash cells with ice-cold PBS, and lyse them in extra strong lysis buffer. Incubate on ice, sonicate, and centrifuge.

steps.title: Perform SDS-PAGE
steps.instruction: Load 40 μg of protein onto SDS-PAGE gels, transfer to nitrocellulose membranes, block, and probe with primary and secondary antibodies.

steps.title: Conduct Immunocytochemistry
steps.instruction: Fix cells in paraformaldehyde, permeabilize, block, and incubate with primary antibodies followed by secondary antibodies. Stain nuclei with Hoechst 33342.

steps.title: Analyze Neurite Outgrowth
steps.instruction: Fix co-cultured cells, stain nuclei, capture images, and measure neurite lengths using ImageJ.

steps.title: Cell Preparation
steps.instruction: Enrich A-CD8+ T cells from individual A to obtain 2 × 10^6 cells.

steps.title: Cell Stimulation
steps.instruction: Stimulate A-CD8+ T cells with 1 × 10^6 B-APCs from individual B in 24-well plates, adding IL-2 (20 U/ml), IL-7 (50 ng/ml), and IL-15 (50 ng/ml).

steps.title: Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the stimulated cells for 9 days to allow for expansion.

steps.title: Cell Enrichment
steps.instruction: After incubation, enrich the in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28− T cells.

steps.title: CFSE Labeling
steps.instruction: Label A-CD4+ T cells from individual A with CFSE at a concentration of 5 × 10^4 cells/well.

steps.title: Co-culture Setup
steps.instruction: Co-culture CFSE-labeled A-CD4+ T cells with either B-APCs or I-APCs at 5 × 10^4 cells/well in a 96-well round bottom plate, with or without the in vitro-expanded CD8+ CD28− T cells at 2.5 × 10^4 cells/well.

steps.title: Incubation for Proliferation
steps.instruction: Incubate the co-culture for 7 days and then for an additional 11 days.

steps.title: Proliferation Assessment
steps.instruction: Use the CFSE dilution assay to assess the proliferation of CD4+ T cells after the incubation periods.

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the percentage of proliferating A-CD4+ T cells and compare the suppression effects between B-APCs and I-APCs.

steps.title: Seed Sowing
steps.instruction: Sow seeds of Phaseolus vulgaris genotypes in vermiculite and place them in a growth chamber at 23°C with a 16 h light/8 h dark cycle and 75% relative humidity.

steps.title: Seedling Cultivation
steps.instruction: Grow seedlings in plastic pots filled with moist vermiculite for 10-12 days until primary leaves are fully expanded.

steps.title: Transplant Seedlings
steps.instruction: Transplant three seedlings into a 20 cm plastic pot filled with moist vermiculite and place them in a dark room for 24 hours prior to inoculation.

steps.title: Prepare DNA-Plasmid Mix
steps.instruction: For primary inoculation, prepare a 20 μL DNA-plasmid mix using 50 mM potassium phosphate buffer, pH 7.0.

steps.title: Prepare Leaf Sap for Secondary Inoculation
steps.instruction: For secondary inoculations, grind an infected leaf of P. vulgaris cv. Black Valentine in a mortar with mock buffer to create leaf sap.

steps.title: Perform Primary Inoculation
steps.instruction: Inoculate one primary leaf of the seedlings by mechanical rubbing with the prepared DNA-plasmid mix.

steps.title: Perform Secondary Inoculation
steps.instruction: Inoculate the seedlings with the prepared leaf sap from the infected leaf using mechanical rubbing.

steps.title: Incubate Inoculated Plants
steps.instruction: Allow the inoculated plants to grow at 19°C under a 16 h light/8 h dark cycle in a growth chamber.

steps.title: GFP Imaging
steps.instruction: Examine GFP expression in aerial organs and roots using a UV lamp and photograph the results with a digital camera.

steps.title: RNA Extraction and cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA and synthesize cDNA as per the established protocols.

steps.title: Perform RT-PCR
steps.instruction: Use specific primers to amplify the PvPDS gene and the internal control PvUBI gene, followed by analysis of PCR products using agarose-ethidium bromide electrophoresis.

steps.title: Map R-BPMV Gene
steps.instruction: Use MAPMAKER software to analyze segregation ratios and establish linkage groups for the R-BPMV resistance gene.

steps.title: Obtain Patient Samples
steps.instruction: Collect a total of 166 blood samples from 41 patients who meet the World Health Organization criteria for probable SARS cases.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Lines
steps.instruction: Culture all cell lines in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM) supplemented with 10% fetal calf serum and penicillin/streptomycin.

steps.title: Construct QT6/ACE2 Cell Line
steps.instruction: Clone the ACE2 gene from a human kidney cDNA library and subclone it into pcdna3.1+. Transfect QT6 cells using lipofectamine 2000 and select for G418-resistant cells.

steps.title: Split 293T Cells
steps.instruction: Split confluent plates of 293T cells at a ratio of 1:4 the day before transfection.

steps.title: Transfect 293T Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect each plate of 293T cells with 1 μg gag/pol construct, 1.5 μg enhanced GFP reporter construct, and 1.5 μg envelope-expressing construct using Fugene-6 transfection reagent.

steps.title: Harvest Viral Supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant from transfected 293T cells 48 hours and 72 hours post-transfection, filter through 0.45-μm filters, and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Measure Viral Titer
steps.instruction: Infect 293T, TE671, and QT6/ACE2 cells with the harvested viral supernatant and measure eGFP titers 72 hours later using fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS).

steps.title: Heat Inactivate Serum Samples
steps.instruction: Heat inactivate patient serum samples at 56°C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Live Virus Neutralization Assay
steps.instruction: Dilute the heat-inactivated serum samples serially from 1:10 in culture medium, add 50 PFU of SARS Frankfurt strain, and incubate for 1 hour at 37°C before adding Vero E6 cells.

steps.title: Assess Neutralization by CPE
steps.instruction: Incubate the virus and serum mix with Vero E6 cells in 96-well plates for 4 days, then assess neutralization based on cytopathic effect (CPE).

steps.title: Perform Pseudotype Neutralization Assay
steps.instruction: Dilute heat-inactivated serum samples 2-fold from 1:10 and mix with MLV(SARS) virions at a 1:1 vol/vol ratio, then incubate for 1 hour at 37°C.

steps.title: Add Serum Dilutions to QT6/ACE2 Cells
steps.instruction: Add 100 μL of each serum dilution to QT6/ACE2 cells seeded at 1 × 10^4 cells per well in 96-well plates and incubate.

steps.title: Count GFP-Positive Cells
steps.instruction: Count the number of GFP-positive cells 48 hours after adding the serum dilutions using fluorescence microscopy.

steps.title: Generate stn1 mutants
steps.instruction: Cross Arabidopsis ecotypes with short and long telomeres to produce stn1 mutants.

steps.title: Analyze phenotypes
steps.instruction: Categorize the resulting stn1 mutants into five phenotypic categories based on growth defects and reproductive capabilities.

steps.title: Assess telomere length
steps.instruction: Measure the average telomere length in G1 stn1 mutants and compare it with G1 stn1(W/C) mutants.

steps.title: Generate exo1 stn1 mutants
steps.instruction: Create exo1a exo1b stn1 mutants by disrupting both EXO1 paralogues in Arabidopsis.

steps.title: Evaluate developmental defects
steps.instruction: Compare the growth defects and fertility of G1 exo1 stn1 mutants with G1 stn1 mutants.

steps.title: Perform TRF analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct terminal restriction fragment analysis to quantify telomeric DNA in stn1 and exo1 stn1 mutants.

steps.title: Conduct in gel hybridization
steps.instruction: Use in gel hybridization to compare G-overhang sizes between stn1 and exo1 stn1 plants.

steps.title: Generate telomerase-null mutants
steps.instruction: Create telomerase-null stn1 and exo1 stn1 mutants by disrupting the TERT gene.

steps.title: Assess growth defects in telomerase-null mutants
steps.instruction: Evaluate the growth defects in stn1 tert and exo1 stn1 tert mutants compared to their respective controls.

steps.title: Quantify telomere length
steps.instruction: Measure and compare telomere lengths among siblings from stn1 tert and exo1 stn1 tert mutants.

steps.title: Perform t-circle amplification assay
steps.instruction: Analyze t-circle abundance in pol α and icu2-1 mutants to assess telomere dysfunction.

steps.title: Analyze chromosome fusions
steps.instruction: Use fusion PCR to detect chromosome end-to-end fusions in stn1, pol α, and icu2-1 mutants.

steps.title: Evaluate anaphase bridges
steps.instruction: Count the frequency of anaphase bridges in pol α and icu2-1 mutants to assess genome instability.

steps.title: Cell Line Selection
steps.instruction: Select three human metastatic TNBC cell lines: BT-549, MDA-MB-468, and MDA-MB-231 for the study.

steps.title: Agonist Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat MDA-MB-231 and MDA-MB-468 cells with ATP and BT-549 cells with histamine to evoke cytosolic Ca2+ transients.

steps.title: MCU Silencing
steps.instruction: Use short-interfering RNA (siRNA) to silence MCU in the selected TNBC cell lines and confirm silencing efficiency.

steps.title: Mitochondrial Ca2+ Uptake Measurement
steps.instruction: Measure mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake in response to agonist treatment in MCU-silenced cells and compare with control cells.

steps.title: Wound Healing Assay
steps.instruction: Perform a wound healing migration assay to assess the effect of MCU silencing on cell motility in all TNBC lines.

steps.title: Cytosolic Ca2+ Transient Measurement
steps.instruction: Measure agonist-induced cytosolic Ca2+ transients in BT-549 and MDA-MB-231 cells to evaluate the impact of MCU silencing.

steps.title: SOCE Measurement
steps.instruction: Assess store-operated Ca2+ entry (SOCE) in MCU-silenced and control cells using various protocols to deplete Ca2+ stores.

steps.title: Spheroid Formation Assay
steps.instruction: Generate stable MCU-silenced cells and perform an in vitro spheroid formation assay to evaluate invasion potential.

steps.title: In Vivo Tumor Analysis
steps.instruction: Use CRISPR/Cas9 technology to generate MCU−/− MDA-MB-231 cells and inject them into SCID mice for tumor growth analysis.

steps.title: Tumor Measurement
steps.instruction: Monitor tumor size, lymph node infiltration, and metastasis formation in mice injected with MCU−/− cells versus control cells.

steps.title: NADH and ATP Measurement
steps.instruction: Measure cellular and mitochondrial NADH levels, NADPH levels, and ATP production using live cell fluorescent and luminescent techniques.

steps.title: Mitochondrial ROS Measurement
steps.instruction: Use the pHyper-dMito protein sensor to measure mitochondrial hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) levels in MCU-silenced cells.

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze all collected data to assess the impact of MCU silencing on mitochondrial Ca2+ uptake, cell migration, and redox metabolism.

steps.title: Cell Suspension Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare a cell suspension of planarian cells for staining.

steps.title: Staining with Hoechst and MTG
steps.instruction: Stain the cell suspension with Hoechst 33,342 and MTG to visualize the nuclear content and mitochondrial mass.

steps.title: Cell Population Identification
steps.instruction: Identify three distinct cell populations (X1, X2, Xins) based on their nuclear content using fluorescence microscopy.

steps.title: Verapamil Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the cells with Verapamil to inhibit efflux pumps and then restain with MTG to assess changes in fluorescence intensity.

steps.title: Antibody Generation
steps.instruction: Generate and characterize an antibody specific to PIWI-1 for subsequent immunostaining.

steps.title: Immunostaining with PIWI-1 Antibody
steps.instruction: Perform immunostaining of planarian cells using the generated PIWI-1 antibody to identify High, Low, and negative PIWI-1 expressing cells.

steps.title: Flow Cytometry Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the stained cells by flow cytometry to separate populations based on PIWI-1 expression and cell size.

steps.title: RNA Sequencing
steps.instruction: Perform RNA sequencing on the X1-MTG Low and X1-MTG High populations to analyze gene expression differences.

steps.title: Gene Ontology Analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct gene ontology analysis on differentially expressed genes to identify functional categories related to differentiation.

steps.title: Transcriptome Comparison
steps.instruction: Compare the transcriptome data of X1-MTG Low and High cells with published single-cell transcriptome data to assess neoblast heterogeneity.

steps.title: X2 Population Analysis
steps.instruction: Stain the X2 population with PIWI-1 antibody and analyze the expression patterns of PIWI-1 in relation to MTG signals.

steps.title: RNA-seq on X2 Populations
steps.instruction: Perform RNA sequencing on the four populations derived from X2-MTG Low and High cells to investigate their transcriptomic profiles.

steps.title: Cell Cycle Analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct cell cycle analysis on sorted cells from X2-MTG Low to confirm their phase in the cell cycle.

steps.title: Transplantation Experiment
steps.instruction: Inject the MTG populations into lethally irradiated animals to assess their potential as pluripotent stem cells.

steps.title: Animal Preparation
steps.instruction: Use fluorescence reporter mice or ICR mice for the experiments. Sacrifice the mice by cervical dislocation at E15.5 or E16.5.

steps.title: Tissue Dissection
steps.instruction: Surgically excise the epididymides from the mice, ensuring to include the region of the vas deferens close to the tail.

steps.title: Tissue Fixation
steps.instruction: Fix the dissected epididymides with either 4% PFA in PBS for 2 hours at 4°C or 20 minutes at 37°C, or with 2% TCA in Ca2+- and Mg2+-free PBS for 20 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Blocking
steps.instruction: Block the samples by incubating in 10% normal goat serum or normal donkey serum diluted in 0.1% Triton X-100/PBS for 3 hours at 37°C.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples with primary antibodies overnight at 4°C.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples with secondary antibodies conjugated to Alexa Fluor 546 or Alexa Fluor 647 overnight at 4°C.

steps.title: Visualization Staining
steps.instruction: Stain the samples with TRITC-conjugated phalloidin and Hoechst 33342 for visualization of F-actin and DNA, respectively.

steps.title: Sample Mounting
steps.instruction: Mount the samples with 10 µl of 1% agarose gel on a glass-based dish for stable imaging.

steps.title: Optical Clearing
steps.instruction: Immerse the samples in BABB solution or CUBIC2 solution for optical clearing.

steps.title: Volumetric Imaging
steps.instruction: Obtain 8-bit volumetric fluorescence images using a confocal laser-scanning platform with appropriate objective lens magnifications.

steps.title: Organ Culture Setup
steps.instruction: Place the epididymides on a hydrophilic polytetrafluoroethylene organ culture insert in a 35 mm Petri dish filled with culture medium at 37°C under 5% CO2.

steps.title: Live Imaging
steps.instruction: Perform live imaging using a multiphoton fluorescence microscope with specified imaging conditions.

steps.title: Tissue Compression Assay
steps.instruction: Prepare the PDMS chamber, place the epididymides in it, fill with collagen, and apply compression before incubating for analysis.

steps.title: Total Protein Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract total protein from the epididymides using RIPA buffer and disrupt using an ultrasonic cell disruptor.

steps.title: Western Blotting
steps.instruction: Prepare lysates for SDS-PAGE, run the gel, transfer proteins to a membrane, and perform immunoblotting with specific antibodies.

steps.title: Scan CoREGs
steps.instruction: Scan each cloned HAG maize CoREG for the presence of an acetyl-CoA-binding site using the Conserved Domain Database (CDD).

steps.title: Align Related Proteins
steps.instruction: Align related proteins using Clustal W with default parameters in the megalign program within the DNASTAR Lasergene package.

steps.title: Align AUX/IAA CoREGs
steps.instruction: Align full-length amino acid sequences of AUX/IAA CoREGs using MUSCLE with specified parameters.

steps.title: Export Alignments
steps.instruction: Export each multiple sequence alignment in Newick format for phylogenetic analysis.

steps.title: Clone Constructs
steps.instruction: Clone constructs into either the pENTR®/D-TOPO® or pENTR®/SD/D-TOPO® vector using high-fidelity Phusion® polymerase.

steps.title: Optimize PCR Conditions
steps.instruction: Optimize PCR conditions by adjusting DMSO, MgCl2, or annealing temperature as needed.

steps.title: Screen Colonies
steps.instruction: Screen kanamycin-resistant colonies for inserts of the correct size and orientation using colony PCR or restriction digestion.

steps.title: Confirm Insert Sequence
steps.instruction: Confirm the sequence of cloned inserts by single-read paired-end Sanger dideoxy sequencing.

steps.title: Isolate DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate genomic DNA from B73 plant tissue using a CTAB-based method.

steps.title: Isolate RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate total RNA from non-starchy B73 tissues using RNAzol® according to the manufacturer's protocol.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Treat total RNA samples with Turbo DNA-free® to remove contaminating DNA, then synthesize complementary DNA using Maxima H Minus® Reverse Transcriptase.

steps.title: Perform RT-PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify TFs by RT-PCR from tissues where they are expected to be highly expressed.

steps.title: Prepare Maize Protoplasts
steps.instruction: Chop and digest leaves from 13-day-old maize seedlings to prepare protoplasts for transformation.

steps.title: Electroporate Protoplasts
steps.instruction: Electroporate protoplasts with total DNA using specified voltage and pulse conditions.

steps.title: Analyze Transformation Efficiency
steps.instruction: Incubate protoplasts and then analyze transformation efficiency by assessing GFP expression under a fluorescence microscope.

steps.title: Probe Design
steps.instruction: Design probes by generating variable length sequences (50- to 100-mers) across the target sequence, ensuring to mask repeats and eliminate probes with excessive matches.

steps.title: Hybridization Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare the array design using the selected probe set and random probes, then hybridize the array with barley cultivars for 4 days following standard CGH protocols.

steps.title: Probe Filtering
steps.instruction: Remove probes based on CGH results, excluding those identified as missed repetitive elements or contaminants, to create a solution-phase capture pool.

steps.title: Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Fragment 1 μg of genomic DNA into 200–300 bp using a Covaris S220 Instrument, then prepare Illumina TruSeq Paired End libraries according to the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Pre-Capture LM-PCR
steps.instruction: Use 20 μl of the TruSeq DNA library in a ligation-mediated PCR reaction to enrich for correctly ligated fragments, then clean up and quantify the DNA.

steps.title: Hybridization Cocktail Preparation
steps.instruction: Add Roche NimbleGen's Plant Capture Enhancer and specific index oligos to the amplified sample library, then dry down the mixture.

steps.title: Hybridization
steps.instruction: Prepare the hybridization sample by adding Sequence Capture Hybridization Buffer and Hybridization Component A, then incubate in a thermocycler for 64–72 hours.

steps.title: Bead Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare Streptavidin Dynabeads for affinity purification by vortexing, aliquoting, and washing them before adding the hybridization sample.

steps.title: Capture Binding
steps.instruction: Mix the hybridization sample with the Dynabeads and incubate at 47°C for 45 minutes, ensuring the beads remain in suspension by vortexing periodically.

steps.title: Washing Dynabeads
steps.instruction: Wash the Dynabeads with SC Wash Buffer I and Stringent Wash Buffer, ensuring to maintain the temperature and discarding the supernatant after each wash.

steps.title: Library Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the bead-bound captured library using LM-PCR, then clean up the reaction using the Qiaquick PCR purification kit according to the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Library Quantification
steps.instruction: Quantify the purified library using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer and analyze the library fragments using an Agilent Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Map the target regions against the barley genome assembly using BWA and Mega BLAST, then compute coverage and perform SNP calling using SAMtools.

steps.title: Culture D. coniospora
steps.instruction: Inoculate roughly 10^9 fresh spores of D. coniospora in 100 mL of NGMY medium and culture for 7 days at 25°C.

steps.title: Harvest mycelia
steps.instruction: After 7 days, harvest the mycelia by vacuum filtering through a sterile 10 μm nylon membrane.

steps.title: Dry mycelia
steps.instruction: Place the filter containing mycelia in a 30°C incubator for approximately 3 hours until dry.

steps.title: Grind mycelia
steps.instruction: Manually grind the dried mycelia in a liquid nitrogen-cooled mortar.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer a 20 mg aliquot of the ground mycelia to a 1.5 mL tube and extract DNA using the DNeasy Plant Mini Kit according to the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Prepare RNA samples
steps.instruction: Collect fresh spores from 10 cm NGM plates of infected worms and inoculate in 100 mL of NGMY liquid medium, culturing for either 4 days or through serial cultures.

steps.title: Filter and freeze samples
steps.instruction: Filter the cultures through 0.22 μm Steritop units, flash freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Homogenize samples for RNA extraction
steps.instruction: Dissolve 200 mg of spores or mycelia in 1 mL Trizol in lysing matrix tubes, homogenize for 20 seconds at 6 m/s, incubate on ice for 2 minutes, and homogenize a second time.

steps.title: Purify RNA
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA using a standard protocol and clean it with an RNeasy mini Kit.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Prepare MIseq paired-end libraries from genomic DNA and sequence on an Illumina MIseq sequencer following the manufacturer's standard procedures.

steps.title: Perform SOLiD sequencing
steps.instruction: Prepare two mate-paired libraries from D. coniospora genomic DNA, shearing DNA to 1.5 kb or 3 kb fragments, and amplify through 14 rounds of PCR.

steps.title: Size-select and purify fragments
steps.instruction: Size-select fragments between 250 and 300 bp using a 4% acrylamide gel and purify with the SOLiD Library Micro Column Purification Kit.

steps.title: Perform de novo genome assembly
steps.instruction: Process MIseq reads with BBDuk to filter contaminants and low-quality reads, then perform de novo genome assembly using Velvet, SPAdes, SOAPdenovo2, and ABySS.

steps.title: Conduct optical mapping
steps.instruction: Generate a whole genome map using the Argus Whole-Genome Mapping System and sort molecules longer than 200 kb for assembly.

steps.title: Perform gene prediction
steps.instruction: Use Augustus for gene prediction on the assembled genome, trained with Trinity-derived transcripts, and annotate using Interproscan.

steps.title: siRNA Dispensing
steps.instruction: Dispense siRNA SMARTpools at 0.3 µM in 10 µl volumes into triplicate black 384-well plates using a Rapidplate384 liquid handler.

steps.title: Plate Sealing and Storage
steps.instruction: Seal the plates with adhesive seals and plastic lids, then store them at −80°C for a minimum of 24 hours and a maximum of 48 hours.

steps.title: Thaw Plates
steps.instruction: On the day of transfection, thaw the assay plates at room temperature.

steps.title: Add Transfection Reagent
steps.instruction: Add 10 µl of transfection reagent diluted in Hank's buffered saline solution to each well using a Multidrop 384.

steps.title: Incubate for Complex Formation
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates at room temperature for 20 minutes to allow the formation of transfection complexes.

steps.title: Prepare HeLa Cells
steps.instruction: Wash low-passage HeLa cells in PBS, trypsinize them, and dilute in phenol red-free, antibiotic-free transfection medium.

steps.title: Count and Seed Cells
steps.instruction: Count the cells and add 3×10^3 cells in 40 µl to each well using the Multidrop 384.

steps.title: Incubate Cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates for 48 hours at 37°C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2.

steps.title: Infection Setup
steps.instruction: Remove media from the plates by inversion and add 10 µl of infection media or virus using the Multidrop 384.

steps.title: Incubate for Infection
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates at 37°C for 1 hour before adding 50 µl of infection media and returning the plates to the incubator.

steps.title: Monitor Virus Replication
steps.instruction: Monitor virus replication as a function of eGFP fluorescence from 24 to 80 hours post-infection using a plate reader.

steps.title: Cell Viability Assay
steps.instruction: Add 5 µl of CellTiter Blue reagent to each well and incubate for 2 hours at 37°C before measuring fluorescence.

steps.title: Data Normalization
steps.instruction: Normalize the readings to the viability of mock-transfected cells and calculate the mean cell viability over three replicates.

steps.title: Deconvolution of siRNA SMARTpools
steps.instruction: Dilute individual siRNAs and reconstituted SMARTpool to 0.3 µM, dispense into plates, and perform transfection and infection as previously described.

steps.title: Validation of Phenotype
steps.instruction: Calculate replication slopes and normalize them; validate the phenotype if two or more siRNAs show the same or better results.

steps.title: Select AAV Vector
steps.instruction: Choose the serotype 6 AAV (AAV6) vector for its infectivity in mouse and human embryonic stem cells.

steps.title: Prepare Viral Vectors
steps.instruction: Prepare viral vectors (AAV, adenoviral, and lentiviral) encoding enhanced green fluorescent protein (EGFP) driven by the CAG promoter.

steps.title: Microinject Viral Vectors
steps.instruction: Microinject each viral vector into the perivitelline space of pronuclear-stage mouse embryos.

steps.title: Confirm EGFP Expression
steps.instruction: At the morula/blastocyst stage, confirm the expression of EGFP under a fluorescence microscope.

steps.title: Remove Zona Pellucida
steps.instruction: Remove the zona pellucida from embryos to enable efficient infection by the lentiviral vector.

steps.title: Electroporate Embryos
steps.instruction: Introduce Cas9-RNP into pronuclear-stage embryos by electroporation.

steps.title: Inject scAAV Vector
steps.instruction: Inject a self-complementary AAV (scAAV) vector harboring a donor DNA cassette into the embryos post-electroporation.

steps.title: Assess Knockin Efficiency
steps.instruction: At the blastocyst stage, assess the efficiency of knockin at the Rosa26 locus.

steps.title: Confirm Germline Transmission
steps.instruction: Breed knockin founders with wild-type mice and genotype N1 generation offspring to confirm germline transmission.

steps.title: Perform Flow Cytometry
steps.instruction: Conduct flow cytometry on peripheral blood to confirm EGFP expression in offspring.

steps.title: Analyze Integration Sites
steps.instruction: Perform Sanger sequencing and restriction fragment-length polymorphism analysis to confirm correct insertion of the donor DNA.

steps.title: Evaluate Phenotype Rescue
steps.instruction: Assess the restoration of the nude phenotype in mice with exchanged wild-type exon 3.

steps.title: Cell Culture Setup
steps.instruction: Grow 293T and 293L cells in high-glucose DMEM supplemented with 8% bovine growth serum, 2 mM l-glutamine, penicillin, and streptomycin. For specific 293L cells, add 50μg/mL hygromycin B.

steps.title: Induction of iSLK.219 Cells
steps.instruction: Maintain iSLK.219 cells in DMEM with 10% Tet-Free Fetal Bovine Serum and antibiotics. Induce cells with doxycycline as needed.

steps.title: Transduction of BCBL-1 Cells
steps.instruction: Transduce BCBL-1 cells with shRNA PRMT5 lentiviral vectors and select using 1μg/mL puromycin.

steps.title: Lentiviral Vector Production
steps.instruction: Transfect 293T cells with pLVX-ORF59-Flag or pLVXdsRed-ORF59-Flag lentiviral vectors along with packaging vectors to produce virions.

steps.title: Transduction of Target Cells
steps.instruction: Add collected viruses to target cells for transduction and select with puromycin (2 mg/ml) to obtain a pure population.

steps.title: Transfection of BAC16 ORF59-Flag
steps.instruction: Transfect BAC16 ORF59-Flag into 293L cells using Metafectene Pro and select with hygromycin.

steps.title: Cell Harvesting
steps.instruction: After 48 hours post-transfection, harvest the transfected 293T cells for immunoprecipitation assays.

steps.title: Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Wash harvested cells with ice-cold PBS and lyse in ice-cold RIPA buffer supplemented with protease inhibitors.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: Preclear lysates with Protein A-Protein G-conjugated Sepharose beads, then add antibodies to capture proteins overnight at 4°C.

steps.title: Western Blotting
steps.instruction: Wash immunoprecipitated complexes, boil in Laemmli buffer, resolve on SDS-PAGE, and transfer to nitrocellulose membranes for antibody incubation.

steps.title: Chromatin Immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: Cross-link approximately 20 million cells with formaldehyde, then wash and lyse to isolate nuclei for chromatin preparation.

steps.title: Sonication of Chromatin
steps.instruction: Sonicate chromatin to an average length of 700 bp, then centrifuge to remove debris.

steps.title: ChIP Assay
steps.instruction: Preclear chromatin with salmon sperm DNA-protein A-protein G Sepharose slurry, then capture chromatin with specific antibodies overnight.

steps.title: DNA Elution and Purification
steps.instruction: Elute chromatin in an elution buffer, reverse cross-link, treat with proteinase K, and purify DNA using Qiagen Min-Elute PCR purification columns.

steps.title: Library Preparation for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Prepare DNA sequencing libraries from extracted DNA using the NEXTflex Illumina ChIP-Seq Library Preparation Kit and analyze for purity.

steps.title: Dissection of Drosophila Larval Brains
steps.instruction: Dissect the required number of Drosophila larval brains in PBS after 48 hours of larval hatching.

steps.title: Fixation of Drosophila Larval Brains
steps.instruction: Fix the dissected larval brains with 1% formaldehyde in PBS for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Quenching Fixation
steps.instruction: Quench the fixation by adding 125 mM glycine to the fixed larval brains.

steps.title: Dissociation of Cells
steps.instruction: Dissociate the fixed larval brains and resuspend the cells according to the established method.

steps.title: Cell Sorting of Drosophila NSCs
steps.instruction: Sort the dissociated cells on a BD FACSAria based on GFP strength and NSC size to obtain a pure population of type II NSCs.

steps.title: Fixation of K562 Cells
steps.instruction: Fix K562 cells cultured in RPMI medium with 10% Fetal Bovine Serum for 10 minutes at room temperature using 1% formaldehyde.

steps.title: Quenching Fixation of K562 Cells
steps.instruction: Quench the crosslinking in K562 cells with 125 mM glycine.

steps.title: Cell Sorting of K562 Cells
steps.instruction: Sort 100 K562 cells using Hoechst stain on a BD FACSAria cell sorter and collect them in RIPA buffer.

steps.title: Sonication of NSCs
steps.instruction: Resuspend 1.2 million FACS sorted NSCs in 140 mM RIPA and sonicate for 14 cycles at high settings.

steps.title: Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sonicated samples overnight with 2 μg of specific antibody at 4°C with head-over-tail rotations.

steps.title: Bead Capture of Antibodies
steps.instruction: Add 20 μl of blocked Protein A and G Dynabeads to the samples and incubate for 3 hours to capture the antibodies.

steps.title: Washing Beads
steps.instruction: Wash the beads with specified buffers: once with 140 mM RIPA, four times with 250 mM RIPA, and twice with TE buffer.

steps.title: Proteinase K Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the samples with Proteinase K for 12 hours at 37°C and at least 6 hours at 65°C to reverse cross-links.

steps.title: DNA Recovery and Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Recover the DNA from the samples, dissolve in TE buffer, and prepare libraries using the NebNext Ultra II DNA library preparation kit.

steps.title: PCR Amplification and Purification
steps.instruction: Amplify the libraries using PCR, purify with Ampure Xp beads, and analyze the size distribution and concentration.

steps.title: Gene Screening
steps.instruction: Screen publicly available datasets for Arabidopsis genes of unknown function that exhibit transcriptional signatures of CBGs or CCGs.

steps.title: Protein Expression Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform immunoblot analyses using BCM1 antiserum raised against recombinant Arabidopsis His-BCM1 to assess BCM1 protein accumulation in various tissues.

steps.title: Transient Expression in Protoplasts
steps.instruction: Fuse BCM1 to yellow fluorescent protein (YFP) and express in Arabidopsis protoplasts to observe chloroplast localization.

steps.title: Chloroplast Fractionation
steps.instruction: Isolate envelope, stroma, and thylakoid fractions from chloroplasts and analyze BCM1 distribution using immunoblotting.

steps.title: Mutant Characterization
steps.instruction: Characterize the status of TBS in bcm1 mutants and BCM1-overexpressing plants to assess their chlorophyll accumulation and phenotypes.

steps.title: ALA Synthesis Measurement
steps.instruction: Measure ALA synthesis rates in bcm1 mutants and BCM1-OX seedlings to evaluate the impact of BCM1 on chlorophyll biosynthesis.

steps.title: Protein Level Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform immunoblot analyses to assess the levels of chlorophyll biosynthesis enzymes (CBEs) in bcm1 and BCM1-OX seedlings.

steps.title: Genetic Interaction Studies
steps.instruction: Combine bcm1-3 mutants with gun5 and gun4 mutants to investigate the genetic interactions affecting chlorophyll biosynthesis.

steps.title: Yeast Two-Hybrid Screening
steps.instruction: Conduct a yeast two-hybrid screen to identify potential protein partners of BCM1 in the TBS pathway.

steps.title: In Vitro MgCh Activity Assay
steps.instruction: Isolate thylakoid membranes from bcm1-3 gun4-1 and BCM1-OX3/gun4-1 seedlings, and perform MgCh activity assays with recombinant components.

steps.title: Recombinant Protein Expression
steps.instruction: Express His-BCM1 in Saccharomyces cerevisiae cells and analyze its effect on MgCh activity using isolated yeast membranes.

steps.title: Purification of BCM1
steps.instruction: Purify recombinant His-BCM1 proteins using a non-ionic detergent and assess their impact on MgCh activity in vitro.

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the results from all experiments to draw conclusions about the role of BCM1 in chlorophyll biosynthesis and MgCh activity.

steps.title: Mouse Strain Preparation
steps.instruction: Obtain the required mouse strains: C57BL/6, Tlr7−/−, Tlr9−/−, and Myd88−/−. Confirm that all strains have a C57BL/6 background of greater than 95% by microsatellite genotyping.

steps.title: Parasite Acquisition
steps.instruction: Acquire P. berghei strain ANKA (MRA-311) parasites from the MR4 stock center and maintain them in C57BL/6 mice.

steps.title: Blood Harvesting
steps.instruction: On day 5 of infection, harvest blood by cardiac puncture from an infected mouse to obtain infected erythrocytes.

steps.title: Infection of New Mouse
steps.instruction: Introduce 10^6 infected erythrocytes into a new mouse via intraperitoneal injection in 100 μl of Alsever’s solution.

steps.title: Initiate Infections
steps.instruction: Initiate infections at 14:00 hours using the previously prepared infected mice.

steps.title: Monitor Survival and Symptoms
steps.instruction: Monitor the mice daily for survival and signs of cerebral malaria, increasing monitoring to twice daily during the peak lethality period (days 6 through 12).

steps.title: Assess Neurological Symptoms
steps.instruction: Identify any neurological symptoms such as convulsions, ataxia, or paralysis in the mice, and record any deaths occurring on or before day 12 post-infection.

steps.title: Monitor Parasitaemia
steps.instruction: Daily monitor parasitaemia by performing Giemsa-stained thin film blood smears to determine the percentage of parasite-infected erythrocytes.

steps.title: Cytokine Analysis Preparation
steps.instruction: For cytokine analysis, collect blood by submandibular blood collection or cardiac puncture into K2EDTA tubes for plasma isolation.

steps.title: Cytokine Detection
steps.instruction: Measure all plasma cytokines using a multiplexed cytometric bead immunoassay according to the manufacturer’s instructions and detect them on a MAGPIX (Luminex).

steps.title: Statistical Analysis of Cytokines
steps.instruction: Assess the significance of cytokine levels using the Mann–Whitney U test.

steps.title: Statistical Analysis of Survival
steps.instruction: Evaluate the significance of survival courses by comparing Kaplan-Meier curves using the log rank (Mantel-Cox) test.

steps.title: Isolate Myofibers
steps.instruction: Isolate healthy intact myofibers from extensor digitorum longus (EDL) muscles for subsequent experiments.

steps.title: Mechanically Damage Myofibers
steps.instruction: Use a Pasteur pipette to mechanically damage some of the isolated myofibers and confirm damage by observing shrunken morphology.

steps.title: Co-Culture Myofibers
steps.instruction: Co-culture intact myofibers with damaged myofibers to assess the effect of damaged myofibers on satellite cell activation.

steps.title: Incubate Co-Culture
steps.instruction: Incubate the co-culture for 48 to 72 hours to allow for satellite cell activation and proliferation assessment.

steps.title: Perform Immunofluorescence
steps.instruction: Conduct immunofluorescence analysis on the co-cultured myofibers to detect the presence of MYOD+ and Ki67+ satellite cells.

steps.title: Wash and Replace Media
steps.instruction: After co-culturing, wash out the damaged myofibers and replace the culture media with fresh DMEM for an additional 24 hours.

steps.title: Analyze Cell States
steps.instruction: Perform immunofluorescence analysis again to evaluate the proportions of PAX7+ MYOD- quiescent satellite cells after the media change.

steps.title: Proteome Analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct proteome analysis on the supernatant from intact and damaged myofiber cultures to identify potential DMDFs.

steps.title: Prepare Recombinant Proteins
steps.instruction: Prepare recombinant proteins of identified DMDFs (AK-1, CK, GAPDH, PGAM-2, TPI) for treatment of isolated myofibers.

steps.title: Treat Myofibers with DMDFs
steps.instruction: Treat isolated myofibers associated with satellite cells with the recombinant DMDF proteins in a floating culture condition for 72 hours.

steps.title: Perform Immunostaining
steps.instruction: Immunostain the treated myofibers to assess the activation of satellite cells by measuring PAX7+ MYOD+ and PAX7+ Ki67+ populations.

steps.title: Control Treatments
steps.instruction: Include PBS, BSA, and urease as control treatments to validate the specificity of the DMDF effects on satellite cell activation.

steps.title: Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Analyze the data from immunostaining to determine the effects of DMDFs on satellite cell activation and proliferation.

steps.title: Obtain Ethical Approval
steps.instruction: Secure ethical approval from the relevant committee (Leeds East REC 06/Q1206/180) before proceeding with any experiments.

steps.title: Perform Laser Microdissection
steps.instruction: Use a Zeiss/PALM Microscope to perform laser microdissection on formalin-fixed/paraffin-embedded tissue to isolate target cell types.

steps.title: Stain Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Conduct SMA staining using mouse monoclonal antibody M851 at a dilution of 1:1000 with an IntelliPATH automated stainer.

steps.title: Culture Cell Lines
steps.instruction: Obtain MCF7 and HB2 cells from the European Collection of Cell Cultures and culture them under appropriate conditions.

steps.title: Transfect Cells
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transfection of pre-/anti-miR and/or plasmids using HiPerFect transfection reagent.

steps.title: Establish Stable Cell Lines
steps.instruction: Generate stable cell lines expressing GFP and firefly luciferase by using the respective expression vectors.

steps.title: Isolate Primary Fibroblasts
steps.instruction: Isolate primary fibroblasts from breast surgical samples and immortalize them using hTERT retroviral transduction.

steps.title: Conduct Functional Assays
steps.instruction: Perform assays for cell viability, cell cycle, apoptosis, migration, and invasion as previously described.

steps.title: Perform Flow Cytometry
steps.instruction: Use LSRII and MoFlo machines for flow cytometry and fluorescence-activated cell sorting, respectively.

steps.title: Conduct Spheroid Invasion Assays
steps.instruction: Carry out spheroid invasion assays and formalin-fix the spheroids for further analysis.

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Use RecoverAll Total Nucleic Acid Isolation for FFPE to extract RNA from formalin-fixed samples and MirVana miRNA Isolation for miRNA extraction from cell lines.

steps.title: Perform qPCR
steps.instruction: Conduct quantitative PCR analyses in triplicate using Taqman assays on 7500/7900HT machines.

steps.title: Conduct Microarray Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform microarray analyses of miRNA expression using human miRNA v2 arrays and system v1.7 reagents.

steps.title: Analyze Protein Samples
steps.instruction: Separate peptides from processed cell lysates by capillary liquid chromatography and analyze them using tandem mass spectrometry.

steps.title: Perform Statistical Analyses
steps.instruction: Analyze data using Prism for statistical tests and R for mass spectrometry data analysis, applying appropriate normalization and false discovery rate adjustments.

steps.title: Sequence Analysis
steps.instruction: Compile a database of protein sequences from 93 vertebrate TDP43 homologs, categorizing them into NTDs, RRM domains, and CTDs.

steps.title: Calculate Edit Distance
steps.instruction: Calculate the Levenshtein or edit distance normalized to a sequence length of 100 amino acids for each collection to assess sequence diversity.

steps.title: Analyze Amino Acid Composition
steps.instruction: Analyze the amino acid composition of the conserved region (CR) and the intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) surrounding it, comparing them to the structured NTD and RRM domains.

steps.title: Identify Hydrophobic Patterns
steps.instruction: Examine the occurrence of hydrophobic residues in conserved intervals within the IDRs and calculate hydrophobicity using a sliding window approach.

steps.title: Generate TDP43 RRM-GFP Reporter
steps.instruction: Replace the RNA-binding RRM domains of TDP43 with GFP to create a reporter protein (TDP43 RRM-GFP) that forms micron-sized liquid droplets.

steps.title: Transfect Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect living cells with constructs expressing TDP43 RRM-GFP to analyze phase separation behavior.

steps.title: Monitor Fluorescence
steps.instruction: Use high-throughput automated confocal microscopy and flow cytometry to monitor nuclear and total GFP fluorescence in cells expressing TDP43 RRM-GFP.

steps.title: Mutate CTD Sequences
steps.instruction: Introduce systematic mutations in the CTD of TDP43 RRM-GFP to assess their effects on phase separation and splicing.

steps.title: Assess Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Evaluate the phase separation of TDP43 RRM-GFP droplets in cells with wild-type and mutant IDRs to determine the critical concentration for phase separation.

steps.title: Purify Full-Length TDP43
steps.instruction: Purify full-length TDP43 with wild-type and mutant CTDs from bacteria for in vitro phase separation analysis.

steps.title: Test RNA Effects
steps.instruction: Investigate the effect of RNA on the phase separation of purified TDP43 variants at varying concentrations.

steps.title: Analyze Phase Separation Properties
steps.instruction: Characterize the phase separation behavior of purified TDP43 variants to confirm findings from the TDP43 RRM-GFP reporter assay.

steps.title: Evaluate Interaction Types
steps.instruction: Use the live-cell reporter assay to assess the interactions (hydrophobic, π–π, and cation–π) that influence the material properties of TDP43 condensates.

steps.title: Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Culture human U2OS, A549, and mouse J774 cells in DMEM with 10% FBS, 2 mM L-glutamine, and 1% penicillin/streptomycin at 37°C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2.

steps.title: Transfection of 293-FT Cells
steps.instruction: Co-transfect 6 µg of pBABED retroviral plasmids with 3.2 µg pCMV-gag-pol and 2.8 µg pCMV-VSV-G in 70% confluent 293-FT cells using a transfection solution prepared in Opti-MEM and PEI.

steps.title: Medium Replacement
steps.instruction: Replace the medium of the transfected 293-FT cells with fresh full medium 16 hours post-transfection.

steps.title: Collection of Retroviruses
steps.instruction: Collect the retroviruses from the growth medium 24 hours after transfection and filter using 0.45 µm filters.

steps.title: Infection of Target Cells
steps.instruction: Infect approximately 60% confluent target cells with the retroviral medium containing 8 µg/ml polybrene for 24 hours.

steps.title: Selection of Infected Cells
steps.instruction: Select cells that have integrated the retrovirus by treating them with 2 µg/ml puromycin.

steps.title: Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Wash the cells twice with ice-cold PBS, scrape them in lysis buffer on ice, and clarify the cell extracts.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: Incubate clarified lysates with anti-FLAG M2 resin overnight at 4°C on a rotating wheel.

steps.title: Washing Resin
steps.instruction: Wash the resin three times with lysis buffer to remove unbound proteins.

steps.title: Elution of FLAG-Fusion Proteins
steps.instruction: Elute FLAG-fusion proteins from the resin by boiling in SDS sample buffer for 5 minutes at 95°C.

steps.title: SDS-PAGE
steps.instruction: Separate the eluted proteins by electrophoresis on 8% SDS-PAGE gels.

steps.title: Western Blotting
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins onto PVDF or nitrocellulose membranes, block, and incubate with primary antibodies overnight at 4°C.

steps.title: Detection
steps.instruction: Wash membranes and incubate with HRP-conjugated secondary antibodies, followed by detection using ECL reagent.

steps.title: siRNA Transfection
steps.instruction: Transfect cells with 20 nM siRNA using Lipofectamine RNAiMAX and replace the medium with fresh growth medium after 16 hours.

steps.title: RNA Isolation and cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Harvest cells, isolate RNA, and perform cDNA synthesis and RT-PCR according to the manufacturer's guidelines.

steps.title: Fly Preparation
steps.instruction: Obtain Drosophila melanogaster strains, including TBPH-null alleles (tbph Δ23 and tbph Δ142) and wild-type controls.

steps.title: mRNA Isolation
steps.instruction: Isolate mRNAs from the adult heads of TBPH-null and wild-type flies for subsequent analysis.

steps.title: Microarray Hybridization
steps.instruction: Hybridize the isolated mRNAs to GeneChip Drosophila Genome 2.0 Arrays to analyze gene expression patterns.

steps.title: Statistical Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform statistical analysis on the microarray data to identify dysregulated transposons in TBPH-null alleles.

steps.title: qRT-PCR Confirmation
steps.instruction: Conduct quantitative RT-PCR (qRT-PCR) using specific primers to confirm the microarray findings regarding transposon expression.

steps.title: NRTI Treatment
steps.instruction: Administer nucleoside and non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors (NRTIs and NNRTIs) to TBPH-null flies to assess their effects on locomotive defects.

steps.title: RNAi Constructs Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare transgenic flies carrying RNAi constructs against the endogenous mRNA sequence of gypsy for silencing experiments.

steps.title: Neuronal Expression of RNAi
steps.instruction: Express the RNAi constructs in neurons using the pan-neuronal driver elav-GAL4 or the motoneuronal promoter D42-GAL4.

steps.title: Phenotype Assessment
steps.instruction: Evaluate the locomotive phenotypes of TBPH-null larvae expressing RNAi against gypsy compared to controls expressing RNAi against GFP.

steps.title: Dicer-2 Expression Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the expression levels of Dicer-2 and other components of the siRNA machinery in TBPH-null and wild-type flies using qRT-PCR.

steps.title: Pull-Down Assays
steps.instruction: Perform pull-down assays to investigate the interaction between TBPH and Dicer-2 in Drosophila neurons.

steps.title: UAS-Dcr-2 Expression
steps.instruction: Cross transgenic flies containing UAS-Dcr-2 with flies carrying the elav-GAL4 or D42-GAL4 drivers to recover Dcr-2 expression in neurons.

steps.title: Locomotion Recovery Assessment
steps.instruction: Assess the recovery of locomotive abilities in TBPH-null larvae expressing UAS-Dcr-2 compared to those expressing UAS-GFP.

steps.title: Synaptic Growth Analysis
steps.instruction: Examine the growth of motoneuron synaptic terminals and the innervation of muscles in TBPH-null flies expressing Dcr-2.

steps.title: Glial Cell Expression of Dcr-2
steps.instruction: Express Dcr-2 in glial cells using repo-GAL4 and evaluate its effects on locomotive deficiencies in TBPH-null flies.

steps.title: Animal Preparation
steps.instruction: Obtain male albino Wistar rats weighing between 250 to 270 g and maintain them at a constant room temperature of 22°C ± 1°C with 60% relative humidity on a 12:12-hour light-dark cycle.

steps.title: Anesthesia and Surgery Setup
steps.instruction: Anaesthetize the rats with chloral hydrate at a dose of 400 mg/kg and position them in a stereotaxic apparatus according to the brain atlas of Paxinos and Watson.

steps.title: Injection of Treatments
steps.instruction: Administer a single intranigral injection of either 2 μl of vehicle or 2 μg of LPS into the left SN of the rats, depending on the treatment group, 2 hours after the application of the first stressor.

steps.title: Stress Application
steps.instruction: Implement a 9-day variate stressor paradigm for the stressed groups, ensuring that the application of stressors occurs at different times each day to minimize predictability.

steps.title: Body Weight Measurement
steps.instruction: Measure the body weight of the rats at the beginning and the end of the 10-day treatment period to evaluate HPA axis activation.

steps.title: Blood Collection
steps.instruction: After the treatment period, deeply anaesthetize the rats and collect blood from the heart for serum corticosterone measurement.

steps.title: Immunohistochemistry Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare 20-μm coronal sections of the brain on a cryostat at -15°C and mount them on gelatine-coated slides for immunohistological evaluation.

steps.title: Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sections with primary antibodies diluted in TBS containing serum and Triton X-100 for 24 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: After rinsing, incubate the sections with biotinylated secondary antibodies for 2 hours, followed by incubation with ExtrAvidin-Peroxidase solution.

steps.title: Visualization of Peroxidase
steps.instruction: Visualize the peroxidase activity by performing a standard diaminobenzidine-hydrogen peroxide reaction for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the immunohistochemical data by counting the number of positive cells and measuring areas lacking GFAP immunoreactivity using imaging software.

steps.title: RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Dissect the left SN from each rat, snap-freeze in liquid nitrogen, and extract total RNA using the RNeasy kit.

steps.title: cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA from 1 μg of total RNA using the QuantiTect Reverse Transcription Kit according to the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Real-Time PCR
steps.instruction: Perform real-time PCR using iQ SYBR Green Supermix and specific primers, following the thermal cycling conditions provided.

steps.title: Melting Curve Analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct melting curve analysis to confirm the presence of a single PCR product at the predicted melting temperature.

steps.title: Obtain Arabidopsis Accessions
steps.instruction: Acquire Arabidopsis accessions from the Nottingham Arabidopsis Stock Centre and other specified sources.

steps.title: Generate HaRxL62 Construct
steps.instruction: Recombine the corresponding ORF from the signal peptide cleavage site into the Gateway destination binary vector under the control of the Cauliflower mosaic virus 35S promoter.

steps.title: Transform Agrobacterium
steps.instruction: Transfer the construct into Agrobacterium tumefaciens strain GV3101 (pMP90 RK).

steps.title: Transform Arabidopsis
steps.instruction: Transform Arabidopsis accession Col-0 using the floral dipping method with the Agrobacterium containing the HaRxL62 construct.

steps.title: Select Primary Transformants
steps.instruction: Select primary transformants (T1) on soil containing BASTA and verify expression of HaRxL62 by Western blot analysis.

steps.title: Observe T2 Progeny
steps.instruction: Observe the progeny of the T2 generation for 3:1 (BASTA-resistant/BASTA-susceptible) segregation.

steps.title: Select Homozygous Lines
steps.instruction: Select homozygous lines by examining the BASTA resistance of T3 seedlings.

steps.title: Grow Arabidopsis Plants
steps.instruction: Grow Arabidopsis plants at 22°C and 60% humidity under a 10-h photoperiod and a 14-h dark period in controlled growth cabinets.

steps.title: Inoculate with Hpa
steps.instruction: Spray-inoculate Arabidopsis plants with a spore suspension of 5×10^4 conidiospores/ml and cover with a transparent lid to maintain high humidity.

steps.title: Stain Leaves
steps.instruction: Stain leaves inoculated with Hpa using trypan blue to evaluate hyphae growth and HR cell death.

steps.title: Harvest Plants for Conidiospores
steps.instruction: Harvest 5 pools of 3 plants for each Arabidopsis line in 1 ml of water and determine the amount of conidiospores released using a haemocytometer.

steps.title: Extract Total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNAs using TRI reagent and 1-bromo-3-chloropropane, followed by precipitation and purification.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Use 3 µg of total RNA to generate cDNAs in a 20 µl reaction volume according to the Superscript II Reverse Transcriptase protocol.

steps.title: Perform qPCR
steps.instruction: Run qPCR in a 10 µl final volume using SYBR Green mix, diluted cDNAs, and primers, following the specified thermal cycling program.

steps.title: Analyze qPCR Data
steps.instruction: Determine relative expression values using EF-1α as a reference gene and the comparative cycle threshold method.

steps.title: Vaccination of Mice
steps.instruction: Vaccinate BALB/c mice twice at 6–7 week intervals with VRP-SARS-N or control VRP-GFP via intranasal or subcutaneous routes.

steps.title: Challenge with SARS-CoV
steps.instruction: After vaccination, challenge the mice with mouse-adapted SARS-CoV at varying doses ranging from 100 to 10,000 PFUs.

steps.title: Assessment of CD4+ T Cell Response
steps.instruction: Evaluate the CD4+ T cell response in the lungs and airways of the vaccinated mice to determine the specificity and localization of the response.

steps.title: Depletion of Memory CD4+ T Cells
steps.instruction: Systemically deplete memory CD4+ T cells in vaccinated mice two days prior to challenge to assess their role in protection.

steps.title: Replenishment of CD4+ T Cells
steps.instruction: Treat vaccinated mice with CD4+ T-cell-depleting antibody 98 days prior to challenge to confirm the importance of memory CD4+ T cells.

steps.title: Analysis of Cytokine Expression
steps.instruction: Measure IFN-γ mRNA levels in the lungs of VRP-SARS-N-immunized mice at day 1 post-infection to evaluate the immune response.

steps.title: In Vivo Cytokine Expression Assay
steps.instruction: Administer Brefeldin A to mice for 6 hours prior to ex vivo analysis to confirm IFN-γ expression by airway CD4+ T cells.

steps.title: Neutralization of IFN-γ
steps.instruction: Neutralize IFN-γ in the airway prior to infection and every two days thereafter to assess its role in the immune response and protection.

steps.title: Evaluation of Dendritic Cell Migration
steps.instruction: Assess the migration of respiratory dendritic cells to mediastinal lymph nodes to determine the impact of airway CD4+ T cells on CD8+ T cell priming.

steps.title: Histological Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform histological analysis on lung tissues from challenged mice to evaluate pathological changes and correlate with immune responses.

steps.title: Functional Assays of T Cells
steps.instruction: Conduct functional assays to evaluate the effector functions of airway N-specific CD4+ T cells post-challenge.

steps.title: Longitudinal Monitoring of T Cell Populations
steps.instruction: Monitor the dynamics of N-specific CD4+ T cell populations over time after vaccination and challenge to assess memory and functional persistence.

steps.title: Synchronized Egg Isolation
steps.instruction: Synchronize C. elegans by treating gravid adults with alkaline hypochlorite to isolate eggs.

steps.title: Construct Repair Template
steps.instruction: Use SapTrap to construct the 30xlinker::GFP^SEC^TEV::AID degron::3xFLAG repair template (pJW1747) for knock-in into the nhr-25 gene.

steps.title: Prepare Competent Cells
steps.instruction: Generate DH10β competent E. coli cells in-house for plasmid generation.

steps.title: Assemble Repair Template
steps.instruction: Assemble the final repair template using pDD379, annealed oligos, pJW1779, 3′ homology arm PCR product, pJW1347, pDD372, pDD363, and pJW1759.

steps.title: Purify Repair Template
steps.instruction: Purify the pJW1747 repair template using the Invitrogen PureLink HQ Mini Plasmid DNA Purification Kit, including the optional wash step.

steps.title: Prepare Injection Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the injection mix containing 10 ng/µL of pJW1747, 50 ng/µL of pDD121, and co-injection markers.

steps.title: Inject Animals
steps.instruction: Inject N2 animals with the prepared injection mix to generate knock-ins.

steps.title: Verify Knock-ins
steps.instruction: Verify each knock-in junction via PCR using specific primers.

steps.title: Backcross Knock-ins
steps.instruction: Backcross the verified knock-ins five times against wild-type N2 animals to produce JDW58.

steps.title: Excise SEC
steps.instruction: Excise the SEC from JDW58 by heat-shock to produce JDW59.

steps.title: Cross Strains
steps.instruction: Cross JDW58 with CA1200 to generate JDW70, then excise the SEC to produce JDW71.

steps.title: Prepare Auxin Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare 250 mM stock solutions of IAA and NAA in ethanol, and K-NAA in deionized water for auxin experiments.

steps.title: Transfer Larvae to Plates
steps.instruction: Transfer synchronized L1 larval stage animals to NGM agar plates seeded with E. coli OP50.

steps.title: Conduct Auxin Treatment
steps.instruction: Transfer animals to plates treated with IAA, NAA, or K-NAA at the P6.p 2-cell stage.

steps.title: Score Developmental Phenotypes
steps.instruction: Score for anchor cell specification and vulval precursor cell arrest using DIC optics after appropriate growth periods.

steps.title: Plasmid Construction
steps.instruction: Construct the pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids encoding the gRNAs targeting the genes of interest.

steps.title: Transformation of E. coli
steps.instruction: Transform E. coli BL21(DE3)ΔompA (pCasRed) with the constructed pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids.

steps.title: Colony Selection
steps.instruction: Select colonies on LB plates supplemented with chloramphenicol and kanamycin to ensure successful transformation.

steps.title: Colony Counting
steps.instruction: Count the number of colonies to assess the transformation efficiency of the pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids.

steps.title: Design of Donor DNA
steps.instruction: Design 70 bp single-stranded donor DNAs (ss-dDNAs) to delete 30 bp and introduce a premature stop codon in each target gene.

steps.title: Transformation with Donor DNA
steps.instruction: Transform E. coli BL21(DE3)ΔompA (pCasRed) with the pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids and their corresponding ss-dDNAs.

steps.title: Random Colony Selection
steps.instruction: From each transformation, randomly select ten colonies for analysis to identify successful mutations.

steps.title: PCR Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform PCR on the selected colonies to identify those carrying the desired 30 bp deletion.

steps.title: Mutation Efficiency Assessment
steps.instruction: Establish the success rate of mutagenesis by calculating the percentage of colonies with the desired mutation.

steps.title: Selection of Functional gDNAs
steps.instruction: Identify and select functional gDNAs that promote Cas9 cleavage based on transformation efficiency results.

steps.title: Optimization of dDNA Conditions
steps.instruction: Test different lengths and concentrations of dDNAs to optimize conditions for gene knockout.

steps.title: Analysis of Mutation Outcomes
steps.instruction: Analyze the outcomes of mutations to confirm successful gene inactivation and assess the robustness of the method.

steps.title: Documentation of Results
steps.instruction: Document the results of the experiments, including transformation efficiencies and mutation success rates.

steps.title: Mouse Purchase
steps.instruction: Purchase C57BL/6J male mice from the Jackson Laboratory.

steps.title: Genetic Cross
steps.instruction: Generate CX3CR1+/GFP/CCR2+/RFP animals by crossing CX3CR1GFP/GFP/CCR2RFP/RFP with C57BL/6J mice.

steps.title: Chow Treatment
steps.instruction: Starting at 8 weeks old, treat C57BL/6J mice with PLX5622 or control chow for 21 days.

steps.title: Irradiation Setup
steps.instruction: Anesthetize mice with an intraperitoneal injection of ketamine and xylazine, then place them 16.3 cm from a cesium-137 source.

steps.title: Radiation Treatment
steps.instruction: Deliver 1.65 Gy of irradiation on both sides of the head every other day for a total of 10 Gy over 5 days.

steps.title: NOR Test Habituation
steps.instruction: House mice in a room with a reversed light cycle for at least 2 weeks, handling them for 5 minutes each day for 5 days before testing.

steps.title: NOR Test Exploration
steps.instruction: Allow mice to explore an open arena for 10 minutes for two consecutive days, then conduct the NOR test with two identical objects on day 3.

steps.title: NOR Test Novel Object
steps.instruction: On day 4, replace one identical object with a novel object and allow mice to explore for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Euthanize Mice
steps.instruction: Euthanize mice used for Golgi staining at the end of the first NOR test and perfuse with ice-cold PBS.

steps.title: Flow Cytometry Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: For flow cytometry, euthanize mice at the indicated time relative to the last day of fWBI and prepare brain samples.

steps.title: Golgi Staining
steps.instruction: Place brain hemispheres in Golgi staining solution for 14 days, then transfer to 30% sucrose solution overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Brain Sectioning
steps.instruction: Cut brains into 100 μm sections with a vibratome, mount on slides, and dry for 2 days.

steps.title: Data Collection
steps.instruction: Take images of stained samples using a Keyence 7000 system and analyze dendritic spine density.

steps.title: Statistical Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze data from the NOR test, DMP test, and flow cytometry using appropriate statistical methods.

steps.title: Worm Culture
steps.instruction: Grow and maintain worm strains on nematode growth media (NGM) plates seeded with Escherichia coli (OP50) at 20°C.

steps.title: Strain Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the required worm strains by crossing and creating mutants as described in the protocol.

steps.title: Temperature Adjustment
steps.instruction: To induce de-silencing of the pie-1p::GFP(lap)::rpa-1 strain, grow the strain for 1-2 generations at 25°C followed by one generation at 20°C.

steps.title: Microirradiation Setup
steps.instruction: Locate nuclei in the germline and focus the Z-plane on the center of the target nuclei before microirradiation.

steps.title: Microirradiation
steps.instruction: Microirradiate the target nuclei using a single pulse from a 365nm pulsed laser, adjusting the intensity as specified.

steps.title: Live Imaging Preparation
steps.instruction: Position worms for live imaging on a 3% agarose pad or in a live imaging petri dish, ensuring they are in M9 and polystyrene beads.

steps.title: Live Imaging
steps.instruction: Acquire images of live worms at 2-minute intervals, focusing on the microirradiated nuclei and adjusting the Z-stack as necessary.

steps.title: Image Processing
steps.instruction: Process the acquired image stacks in MetaMorph to create maximum projections for each time point.

steps.title: Foci Scoring
steps.instruction: Score the number of foci in each nucleus at every time point using FIJI-ImageJ, recording new foci that appear post-microirradiation.

steps.title: Worm Recovery
