steps.instruction: Recover microirradiated worms by submerging the slide in M9 and gently prying off the coverslip, then transferring worms to NGM plates seeded with OP50.

steps.title: Gonad Dissection
steps.instruction: Dissect the recovered worms to extract their gonads for further analysis.

steps.title: Immunofluorescent Staining
steps.instruction: Fix and stain the extracted gonads with primary and secondary antibodies as specified in the protocol.

steps.title: Distance Measurement
steps.instruction: Use the straight line measurement tool in FIJI-ImageJ to measure distances in μm between foci within mid-pachytene nuclei.

steps.title: Animal Acquisition
steps.instruction: Obtain male 3-month old BALB/cARC and C57BL/6JARC mice from the Animal Resources Centre and house them in groups of four in individually ventilated cages.

steps.title: Environmental Setup
steps.instruction: Maintain the housing environment at 21 ± 1°C and 50 ± 10% humidity with a 12-hour light cycle, marking individual tails for identification.

steps.title: Food Restriction
steps.instruction: Food-restrict mice to 90% of their free-feeding body weight by adjusting daily food amounts, ensuring all mice can consume without fighting.

steps.title: Habituation to Testing Room
steps.instruction: Bring the home cage of mice into the testing room for a minimum of 30 minutes prior to each training session.

steps.title: Touchscreen Setup
steps.instruction: Set up the operant chambers with touchscreens, reward dispensers, and clean all surfaces with 70% ethanol between animals.

steps.title: Reward Acclimation
steps.instruction: Provide a small quantity of strawberry milk in a falcon tube lid in the home cage for 3 days to acclimate mice to the liquid reward.

steps.title: Training - Habituation Stage
steps.instruction: Train mice to collect a reward when the tray illuminates, requiring them to complete 50 trials within 20 minutes over two consecutive sessions.

steps.title: Training - Initial Touch Stage
steps.instruction: Mice learn to touch a white square on the screen to receive a 3× reward or a single reward after 30 seconds of inactivity, progressing after 100 trials.

steps.title: Training - Must Touch Stimuli Stage
steps.instruction: Require mice to touch the stimuli to receive a reward, completing 100 trials in under 30 minutes to progress.

steps.title: Training - Must Initiate Stage
steps.instruction: Mice must enter the reward tray to start trials, completing 100 trials in 60 minutes to advance.

steps.title: Training - Punish Incorrect Stage
steps.instruction: Implement a time-out for incorrect touches, requiring 100 trials in under 60 minutes with at least 70% correct responses.

steps.title: Visual Discrimination Task
steps.instruction: Conduct the VD task where mice discriminate between two visual stimuli, requiring 100 trials in under 60 minutes with at least 80% correct.

steps.title: Reversal Task
steps.instruction: Switch the reward contingency for the reversal task, requiring mice to learn the new pairing until reaching 80% correct or a maximum of 20 sessions.

steps.title: Data Collection
steps.instruction: Collect data on trials completed, session duration, response types, and other measures during touchscreen testing.

steps.title: Behavioral Testing
steps.instruction: Conduct additional behavioral tests such as the Open Field and Forced Swim Test to measure locomotor activity and behavioral despair.

steps.title: Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Maintain DT40, Non-KI(B), KI(B), and KI(MΦ) cell lines as previously described.

steps.title: Prepare gRNA Complex
steps.instruction: Use the complex of CRISPR RNA (crRNA) targeting the Pax5 promoter and trans-activating crRNA (tracrRNA) as Pax5 gRNA for in vitro enChIP.

steps.title: Fragment Chromatin DNA
steps.instruction: Fragment chromatin DNA to an average length of about 2 kbp for subsequent isolation of target regions.

steps.title: Perform iChIP or enChIP
steps.instruction: Isolate the target region using either the iChIP procedure for Non-KI(B), KI(B), and KI(MΦ) or the in vitro enChIP procedure for DT40.

steps.title: Purify DNA
steps.instruction: Purify the isolated DNA from the iChIP or enChIP procedure.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Libraries
steps.instruction: Use the TruSeq ChIP Sample Prep Kit (Illumina) to prepare DNA libraries, concentrating fragments around 0.4 kbp in length.

steps.title: Sequence DNA Libraries
steps.instruction: Subject the prepared DNA libraries to sequencing using the HiSeq platform according to the manufacturer's protocol.

steps.title: Transfect DT40 Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect DT40 cells (1 × 10^7) with 120 µg of Cas9 expression plasmid, 120 µg of sgRNA expression plasmids, and 0.3 µg of pEGFP-N3 using electroporation.

steps.title: Sort GFP-positive Cells
steps.instruction: One day after transfection, sort and expand the GFP-positive cells individually.

steps.title: Extract Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from the sorted cells to confirm targeted locus deletion.

steps.title: Perform Genotyping PCR
steps.instruction: Subject the extracted genomic DNA to genotyping PCR using KOD FX with specified cycling conditions.

steps.title: Extract Total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from the cells as previously described.

steps.title: Perform Quantitative RT-PCR
steps.instruction: Conduct quantitative RT-PCR on the extracted RNA using appropriate primers.

steps.title: Perform ChIP Assays
steps.instruction: Use antibodies against H3K4me1, H3K27ac, and histone H3 to perform ChIP assays with DT40 cells.

steps.title: Analyze ChIP DNA
steps.instruction: Purify the ChIP DNA and use it as a template for real-time PCR with SYBR Select Master Mix.

steps.title: Mouse Housing
steps.instruction: Group house C57BL/6 mice (8 weeks old, 18–22 g) under controlled temperature (25°C) and a 12:12 light-dark cycle with unrestricted access to standard chow and water.

steps.title: DSS Treatment
steps.instruction: Dilute DSS (40,000 Da, 3% wt/vol) in drinking water and provide it to the mice for 7 days.

steps.title: Euthanasia
steps.instruction: After 7 days of DSS treatment, sacrifice the mice using CO2 euthanasia.

steps.title: Tissue Collection
steps.instruction: Collect a small piece (50 mg) of proximal colon from each mouse for RNA extraction.

steps.title: RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Isolate total RNA from the colonic tissues using TRIzol according to the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Lithium Chloride Purification
steps.instruction: Incubate RNA with 0.1 volume of 8 M LiCl on ice for 2 hours, then centrifuge at 14,000 g for 30 minutes at 4°C. Repeat the incubation and centrifugation.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate RNA by adding 0.1 volume of 3 M sodium acetate and 2 volumes of absolute ethanol, then centrifuge at 14,000 g for 30 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: RNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet with 100 μL of 70% ethanol and centrifuge at 14,000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: RNA Resuspension
steps.instruction: Dissolve the RNA pellet in 20–50 μL of RNase-free water.

steps.title: cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA using the Maxima First-Strand cDNA Synthesis Kit according to the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: qPCR Setup
steps.instruction: Quantify the expression of total RNA by performing qPCR using Maxima SYBR Green/ROX qPCR Master Mix in a Realplex Thermal Cycler.

steps.title: Polymerase Activity Assay
steps.instruction: Measure the enzymatic activity of Taq DNA polymerase using the EvaEZ™ Fluorometric Polymerase Activity Assay kit, incubating with water or DSS.

steps.title: Reverse Transcriptase Assay
steps.instruction: Measure the reverse transcriptase activity using the EnzChek Reverse Transcriptase Assay kit, incubating with water or DSS.

steps.title: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR)
steps.instruction: Perform SPR experiments by coupling a gold sensor chip with reverse transcriptase and passing primed RNA over the chip to assess binding.

steps.title: Statistical Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the data using an unpaired two-tailed t-test with GraphPad Prism 5 software, considering p < 0.05 as statistically significant.

steps.title: Cell Isolation
steps.instruction: Obtain plasma cells from the synovial fluid of a patient with anti-CCP-positive RA and isolate antibody-secreting cells from synovial fluid mononuclear cells using the fluorescent foci method.

steps.title: B Cell Sorting
steps.instruction: Sort single citrulline-specific B cells from the peripheral blood of other RA patients using an antigen-tetramer system via flow cytometry.

steps.title: Peptide ELISA Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare peptide ELISAs to assess binding to citrulline-containing and arginine-containing peptides, including specific proteins like filaggrin and vimentin.

steps.title: mAb Dilution for ELISA
steps.instruction: Dilute monoclonal antibodies (mAb) to a concentration of 5 μg/ml, then further dilute down to 0.15 ng/ml for use in the ELISA.

steps.title: Full-Length Protein ELISA Setup
steps.instruction: Dilute 10 μg/ml of fibrinogen, recombinant vimentin, and histone H4 in phosphate buffered saline (PBS) and coat Nunc Maxisorp 96-well plates.

steps.title: Blocking Plates
steps.instruction: Block the coated plates with 5% milk powder in PBS and incubate for 3 hours at 37°C with citrullination buffer or buffer control.

steps.title: ACPA Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates with ACPAs at a concentration of 5 μg/ml, diluted down to 0.15 ng/ml.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Perform sequential incubation with secondary Fc-specific HRP-conjugated anti-human IgG or biotin-conjugated human IgG1-Fc plus HRP-conjugated streptavidin.

steps.title: Development of ELISA
steps.instruction: Develop the ELISA with SeramunBlau fast TMB and read the results using a Spectra Fluor.

steps.title: Microarray Peptide Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize peptides that cover all arginine and lysine sites of extracellular matrix proteins and RA-related proteins, resulting in a total of 172,765 unique peptides.

steps.title: mAb Dilution for Microarray
steps.instruction: Dilute mAb to a concentration of 1 μg/ml, except for mAb 1325:07E07, which should be diluted to 0.55 μg/ml.

steps.title: Scanning for Reactivity
steps.instruction: Scan for citrulline and homocitrulline reactivity with each mAb at a resolution of 2 μm using a NimbleGen MS200 Scanner.

steps.title: Western Blot Preparation
steps.instruction: Solubilize full-length proteins in 8 M urea at 1 mg/ml, then electrophorese 10 μg on 12.5% SDS-PAGE gels and blot onto a nitrocellulose membrane.

steps.title: Western Blot Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the blots overnight at 37°C in citrullination buffer with hPAD2 or buffer control, followed by incubation with ACPAs.

steps.title: Visualization of Western Blots
steps.instruction: Perform visualization of the blots using Amersham Hyperfilm.

steps.title: Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Culture cells in DMEM supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (S+ medium) at 37°C and 5% CO2. Optionally, use different serum-free formulations as specified.

steps.title: Add Ribonuclease Inhibitor
steps.instruction: In selected experiments, add recombinant ribonuclease inhibitor (RI) at a final concentration of 4–8 U/ml either during medium renewal or after collecting cell-conditioned media.

steps.title: Ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell-conditioned medium that has been previously spun at 2000 × g for 2.5 hours at 100,000 × g and 4°C using an ultracentrifuge.

steps.title: Concentrate Supernatant
steps.instruction: Concentrate the supernatant to approximately 250 μl using 10,000 MWCO ultrafiltration units.

steps.title: Size-Exclusion Chromatography
steps.instruction: Dilute the concentrated supernatant with PBS to remove phenol red and small molecules, then inject 500 μl into a Superdex S200 10/300 column and perform size-exclusion chromatography at 0.9 ml/min.

steps.title: Centrifuge Samples
steps.instruction: Before injection into the chromatography columns, centrifuge all samples at 16,000 × g for 10 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Collect Fractions
steps.instruction: Collect 0.25 ml fractions during size-exclusion chromatography while monitoring absorbance at 260 and 280 nm.

steps.title: RNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify RNA from selected chromatographic peaks using TRIzol LS according to the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Prepare RNA for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Dilute the purified RNA in 8 μl of ultra-pure RNase-free water and use 7 μl for next-generation sequencing (NGS) library preparation with the NEBNext Small RNA Library Prep Set.

steps.title: Perform Sequencing
steps.instruction: Sequence the prepared library on a MiSeq benchtop sequencer for 200 cycles.

steps.title: Northern Blotting
steps.instruction: Perform northern blotting using 10% denaturing gels transferred to positively-charged nylon membranes with digoxigenin-labeled DNA probes and alkaline phosphatase-labeled anti-digoxigenin antibody.

steps.title: Visualize Signals
steps.instruction: Visualize the signals from the northern blot using CDP-Star and detect them with a ChemiDoc imaging system.

steps.title: Prepare Dendritic Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare adherent mouse bone marrow-derived dendritic cells (BMDC) as described in the referenced protocol.

steps.title: Add RNA to BMDCs
steps.instruction: Add selected chromatographic fractions or synthetic RNAs to 1 × 10^6 BMDCs.

steps.title: Flow Cytometry Analysis
steps.instruction: After 24 hours, harvest the cells and analyze them by flow cytometry using a CyAn ADP Analyzer.

steps.title: Isolation of T Cells
steps.instruction: Isolate naive T cells from CBA mice for use in the allogeneic mixed lymphocyte reaction (MLR).

steps.title: Setup Allogeneic MLR
steps.instruction: Co-culture isolated naive T cells with B6 BM-DCcons to initiate the allogeneic MLR and stimulate T cell proliferation.

steps.title: Add DCregs to MLR
steps.instruction: Introduce B6 BM-DCregs and iPS-DCregs into the MLR to assess their inhibitory effects on T cell proliferation.

steps.title: Establish OVA-specific MLR
steps.instruction: Co-culture T cells from B6-background TCR transgenic mice OT-II and OT-I with OVA-pulsed B6 BM-DCcons for 3 days.

steps.title: Add DCregs to OVA-specific MLR
steps.instruction: Incorporate B6 BM-DCregs and iPS-DCregs into the OVA-specific MLR to evaluate their regulatory effects on T cell proliferation.

steps.title: Adoptive Transfer of T Cells
steps.instruction: Transfer 3 × 10^6 OT-II or OT-I T cells into wild-type B6 mice one day prior to the next experimental step.

steps.title: Inject DCs into Recipients
steps.instruction: Subcutaneously inject OVA-pulsed B6 BM-DCcons combined with iPS-DCregs into the footpads of the recipient mice.

steps.title: Immunization of Mice
steps.instruction: Immunize CBA mice with B6-derived DCs and isolate spleen cells 7 days post-immunization for further analysis.

steps.title: Flow Cytometry Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform flow cytometry on isolated spleen cells to assess the population of CD25+ FOXP3+ Tregs.

steps.title: Co-culture T Cells for Secondary Immunization
steps.instruction: Elute T cells from spleen cells and co-culture them with B6 BM-DCcons or BALB/c BM-DCcons for secondary immunization.

steps.title: Assess T Cell Proliferation
steps.instruction: Evaluate the proliferation of CD4+ and CD8+ FOXP3− effector T cells after co-culture with B6 BM-DCcons.

steps.title: Intravenous Injection of DCregs
steps.instruction: Inject 1 × 10^6 B6 iPS-DCregs or other B6-derived DCs into CBA recipients 7 days before heart allograft transplantation.

steps.title: Monitor Allograft Survival
steps.instruction: Observe and record the survival time of cardiac allografts in treated recipients.

steps.title: Histological Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform histological examination of allografts to assess lymphocyte infiltration and other pathological changes.

steps.title: Evaluate Cytokine Expression
steps.instruction: Measure the mRNA expression levels of proinflammatory cytokines and other markers in allografts from treated and control groups.

steps.title: Plant Acquisition
steps.instruction: Obtain rooted petunia plantlets (Petunia x hybrida L. lines P720, W115 [cv. MD], Blue Spark, and Blue Ray) from Danziger–Dan Flower Farm.

steps.title: Plant Growth Conditions
steps.instruction: Grow the plants in a greenhouse under a 25/20°C day/night temperature regime and a 12/12 h light/dark photoperiod, starting the light period at 0800 h.

steps.title: Flower Collection for Headspace Analysis
steps.instruction: Collect petunia P720 flowers at various developmental stages (3.5 cm buds to 3 days postanthesis) at 1600 h for dynamic headspace analysis.

steps.title: Initiate Headspace Collection
steps.instruction: For diel floral emissions, collect petunia P720 flowers at anthesis stage and start headspace collection at 0300 h, continuing at 4-hour intervals for 24 hours.

steps.title: Volatile Collection
steps.instruction: Collect volatiles emitted from three detached flowers per sample using an adsorbent trap containing 200 mg Porapak Type Q polymer.

steps.title: Volatile Elution
steps.instruction: Elute trapped volatiles using 1.5 ml hexane and add 2 μg isobutylbenzene as an internal standard to each sample.

steps.title: Petal Tissue Collection
steps.instruction: Collect 150 mg of petal tissues from at least three different flowers and grind in liquid nitrogen for analysis of free volatile compounds.

steps.title: Extraction of Free Volatiles
steps.instruction: Extract ground petal tissues in 800 μl hexane containing 2 μg isobutylbenzene, incubate for 2 hours with shaking, then centrifuge at 10,000 g for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Extraction of Glycosylated Compounds
steps.instruction: Grind corolla limb tissue (150 mg) in liquid nitrogen, suspend in 1.2 ml 80% MeOH:DDW, and sonicate for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifugation and Hydrolysis
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sonicated samples at 16,000 g for 10 minutes, vacuum-dry the supernatant, and resuspend in 0.9 ml 0.2 M citrate–phosphate buffer, pH 5.4.

steps.title: Enzymatic Hydrolysis
steps.instruction: Add 150 μl Viscozyme to the resuspended samples and incubate overnight at 37°C to hydrolyze glycosylated compounds.

steps.title: Final Extraction for GC–MS
steps.instruction: Extract the hydrolyzed samples in 800 μl hexane containing 2 μg isobutylbenzene and prepare for GC–MS analysis.

steps.title: GC–MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform GC–MS analysis using a TRACE GC 2000 and a TRACE DSQ mass spectrometer, following the specified temperature program.

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Identify compounds based on mass spectra and retention times using the NIST/EPA/NIH Mass Spectral Library and compare with authentic standards.

steps.title: Synthesis of desthiobiotin derivatives
steps.instruction: Synthesize TO1-Dtb and TO3-Dtb using TO1-acetate and TO3-acetate along with EZ link amine PEG4 desthiobiotin as precursors.

steps.title: Confirm product identity
steps.instruction: Confirm the identity of the synthesized products by electrospray ionization–mass spectrometry.

steps.title: Prepare streptavidin agarose beads
steps.instruction: Wash 400 µL of streptavidin agarose beads twice with Buffer A and three times with Buffer B.

steps.title: Derivatize agarose beads
steps.instruction: Add 22.5 nmol of TO1-Dtb in 400 µL Buffer B to the washed beads and incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash beads
steps.instruction: Wash the beads once with 400 µL Buffer B to remove unbound dye.

steps.title: Prepare yeast strain
steps.instruction: Transform the U1M gene into the yeast strain yAAH0441 and select transformants on dropout media.

steps.title: Confirm yeast transformants
steps.instruction: Confirm the presence of the U1-Mango gene and absence of the WT allele by PCR and DNA sequencing.

steps.title: Prepare yeast whole-cell extracts
steps.instruction: Prepare whole-cell extracts from the yeast strains yAAH1204 and yAAH1362 using the liquid nitrogen method.

steps.title: Label yeast extracts
steps.instruction: Incubate 500 µL of yeast whole-cell extracts with SNAP-Surface 549 tag and inhibitors at room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Pull-down snRNPs
steps.instruction: Add yeast extracts to TO1-Dtb saturated agarose beads and incubate at 4°C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Wash beads
steps.instruction: Wash the beads twice with Buffer B at 4°C and once more at 30°C.

steps.title: Elute snRNPs
steps.instruction: Elute the snRNPs by adding Buffer B with 20 mM biotin and incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Analyze eluted samples
steps.instruction: Concentrate part of the biotin eluate for SDS-PAGE analysis and process the remaining for RNA analysis.

steps.title: Perform RT-primer extension
steps.instruction: Add labeled primers to the precipitated RNA and carry out reverse transcription at 45°C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Load gels for electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load the reactions onto denaturing and native polyacrylamide gels for electrophoresis and analyze the results.

steps.title: Viral RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract viral RNA from 140 μl of virus culture supernatants or patients' plasma using the QIAamp Viral Min Kit. Elute the RNA in 50 μl of nuclease-free water and store it at -80°C until further use.

steps.title: Obtain DENV-4 3′-UTR Fragment
steps.instruction: Use the StarScript II Probe One-Step qRT-PCR Kit with primers F3/134 and B3/4 to obtain the 3′-UTR fragment of the DENV-4 genome.

steps.title: Sub-clone 3′-UTR Fragment
steps.instruction: Sub-clone the obtained 3′-UTR fragment into the pMD18-T plasmid vector.

steps.title: Construct Mutant Viral RNAs
steps.instruction: Use a fast mutagenesis system to construct various mutants that form mismatches with the F3, FIP, and BLP primers. Confirm the mutants by Sanger sequencing.

steps.title: In vitro Transcription of Mutant RNAs
steps.instruction: Obtain mutant RNAs through in vitro transcription using T7 RNA polymerase.

steps.title: Quantify Mutant RNAs
steps.instruction: Quantify the mutant RNAs using spectrophotometric absorbance at 260 nm and calculate the copy number using the provided formula.

steps.title: Prepare RT-LAMP Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 μl reaction mix for the RT-LAMP assay, including all necessary components such as Bst 2.0 DNA polymerase, WarmStart RT, Q5 High-Fidelity DNA polymerase, primers, and RNA.

steps.title: Perform RT-LAMP Reaction
steps.instruction: Conduct the RT-LAMP reaction at 63°C for 60 minutes, using SYTO 9 as a fluorescent dye for real-time monitoring.

steps.title: Determine Sensitivity and LOD
steps.instruction: Use ten-fold serial dilutions of RNA from DENV stocks to determine the sensitivity and limit of detection (LOD) of the RT-LAMP assay.

steps.title: Evaluate Clinical Samples
steps.instruction: Evaluate the performance of the RT-LAMP assay using 153 plasma samples from dengue-suspected patients, comparing results with NS1 antigen detection and RT-PCR assays.

steps.title: Perform RT-Nested PCR for Confirmation
steps.instruction: For samples with discrepancies between RT-PCR and RT-LAMP results, perform RT-nested PCR using specific outer and inner primers.

steps.title: Visual Detection Method Development
steps.instruction: Add hydroxynaphthol blue (HNB) to the RT-LAMP reaction mix to develop a visual detection method, and observe color changes at specified time points.

steps.title: Bacterial Growth
steps.instruction: Grow Escherichia coli strains NEB5α and BL21(DE3) in LB broth with aeration at 250 rpm until the desired growth is achieved.

steps.title: Plasmid Transformation
steps.instruction: Transform plasmids into E. coli cells using electroporation and select transformants by plating on LB agar with the appropriate antibiotic.

steps.title: Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the plated transformants at 37°C overnight to allow colonies to form.

steps.title: Plasmid Construction
steps.instruction: Use CloneAmp HiFi PCR Premix to amplify DNA and insert M. smegmatis DnaBi1 into kanR of pUC4K using Gibson assembly.

steps.title: Plasmid Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare plasmids using an E.Z.N.A. plasmid minikit for subsequent experiments.

steps.title: Spot Titer Assay Preparation
steps.instruction: Grow M. smegmatis in 7H9 and 7H10 media prior to performing spot titer assays.

steps.title: Subcloning
steps.instruction: Subclone KD154 into the mycobacterial shuttle vector pMBC283 using Gibson assembly for further analysis.

steps.title: Dilution Series
steps.instruction: Prepare two-fold dilutions of M. smegmatis cells starting from OD600 values of 3 to 5 for spot titer assays.

steps.title: Spotting Cells
steps.instruction: Spot 1.25 μl of each dilution onto 7H10 media and incubate at 30°C for 5 days.

steps.title: MIG Reporter Expression
steps.instruction: Express the MIG reporter in BL21(DE3) by subculturing overnight cultures in fresh LB and inducing protein expression at OD600 ∼0.5.

steps.title: Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Resuspend cell pellets in MIG buffer and lyse using a tip sonicator on ice.

steps.title: Sample Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the lysate at 16°C for the specified duration for M. smegmatis DnaBi1 and M. leprae DnaB.

steps.title: Zinc Treatment
steps.instruction: Add zinc acetate to the samples immediately before incubation to assess splicing inhibition.

steps.title: Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Separate samples on 8% to 16% Tris-glycine gels and detect GFP-containing products using an imager.

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Quantify the results using ImageJ and analyze the data with GraphPad Prism.

steps.title: Purification of Antibodies
steps.instruction: Purify polyclonal ACPA IgGs and non-ACPA control IgGs from pooled serum of RA patients and non-pooled sera of ACPA-positive patients. Purify polyclonal antiproteinase 3 IgGs and non-anti-PR3 control IgGs from the sera of a patient with PR3-associated vasculitis.

steps.title: Quality Control Testing
steps.instruction: Perform extensive quality control testing on all purified IgGs, including specificity evaluation, size exclusion chromatography aggregation test, and limulus amebocyte lysate (LAL) endotoxin test.

steps.title: Cell Culture Preparation
steps.instruction: Culture RA-derived and osteoarthritis-derived synovial fibroblasts as well as human dermal fibroblasts for subsequent experiments.

steps.title: Cytokine Treatment
steps.instruction: Culture fibroblasts in the presence or absence of IL-8 or TNF-α to assess their effects on the cells.

steps.title: Migration Assay
steps.instruction: Assess fibroblast migration using either the IncuCyte Zoom live cell imaging system or a scratch assay.

steps.title: Adhesion Assay
steps.instruction: Perform adhesion assays using 16-well E-plates and the xCELLigence System Real-Time Cell Analyzer.

steps.title: Cell Washing and Starvation
steps.instruction: Wash the cells with phosphate buffered saline and starve them for 2 hours in medium without fetal bovine serum before further treatments.

steps.title: Pretreatment with Proteins
steps.instruction: Add citrullinated or native human purified fibrinogen, recombinant vimentin, α-enolase, and histone H4 as pretreatment to ACPA and control IgGs at 4°C overnight.

steps.title: Inhibition of Pathways
steps.instruction: Inhibit PI3K with wortmanin, PTEN with SF-1670, and PAD activity with Cl-amidine or GSK199 for 72 hours prior to scratching.

steps.title: Immunohistochemistry
steps.instruction: Stain fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLS) with primary antibodies followed by HRP-conjugated antibodies, develop with Vectastain Elite ABC and DAB, and counterstain with Mayer’s haematoxylin.

steps.title: Confocal Microscopy
steps.instruction: Incubate cells and tissues with primary and secondary antibodies, then counterstain with 4,6-diamidino-2-phenylindole for confocal microscopy.

steps.title: Mass Spectrometry Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze starved and non-starved FLS whole cell lysates by mass spectrometry to detect citrullination.

steps.title: Western Blot Analysis
steps.instruction: Load cell lysates onto an SDS-PAGE gel, transfer to nitrocellulose membranes, and incubate with primary and peroxidase-conjugated secondary antibodies.

steps.title: Flow Cytometry
steps.instruction: Collect cells using non-enzymatic detachment reagent, stain with fluorochrome-labelled antibodies, and analyze using a FACSVerse flow cytometer.

steps.title: Statistical Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the data using either the Kruskal-Wallis test followed by Dunn’s multiple comparison test or two-way ANOVA followed by Tukey’s post hoc test using GraphPad Prism 6 software.

steps.title: Collect xylem exudate
steps.instruction: Harvest xylem exudate from soybean (Glycine max) plants for peptidomics analysis.

steps.title: Perform peptidomics analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct peptidomics analysis on the collected xylem exudate to identify root-to-shoot mobile peptides.

steps.title: Analyze peptide expression
steps.instruction: Evaluate the expression levels of identified peptides, focusing on XAP4/GmCLE32 in the roots under various conditions.

steps.title: Collect Arabidopsis xylem exudate
steps.instruction: Gather xylem exudate from Arabidopsis plants for nano-liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (nano-LC–MS/MS) analysis.

steps.title: Conduct nano-LC–MS/MS analysis
steps.instruction: Perform nano-LC–MS/MS on the Arabidopsis xylem exudate to detect the presence of the mature CLE2 peptide.

steps.title: Treat plants with DCMU
steps.instruction: Apply the photosynthesis inhibitor 3-(3,4-dichlorophenyl)-1,1-dimethylurea (DCMU) to Arabidopsis plants to assess the expression of CLE2.

steps.title: Measure mRNA levels
steps.instruction: Quantify the mRNA levels of CLE2 and other related CLE genes in treated plants to determine their response to low-carbon conditions.

steps.title: Generate mutant lines
steps.instruction: Create cle2cle3 double mutants and cle1-7 septuple mutants using CRISPR/Cas9 technology for functional analysis.

steps.title: Analyze sugar content
steps.instruction: Measure the sugar (sucrose and glucose) and starch contents in the roots and leaves of the generated mutants.

steps.title: Conduct gain-of-function analysis
steps.instruction: Perform a gain-of-function analysis of CLE2 using the CoYMV promoter in transgenic lines to assess its effect on sucrose levels.

steps.title: Apply synthetic CLE2 peptide
steps.instruction: Transiently apply the synthetic mature CLE2 peptide to the rosette leaves of Arabidopsis plants and measure the effects on sugar content.

steps.title: Evaluate root growth
steps.instruction: Assess the root growth of cle1-7 mutants under normal and fluctuating light conditions, with and without sucrose supplementation.

steps.title: Perform grafting experiments
steps.instruction: Graft cle1-7 and WT plants to investigate the influence of root genotype on SUC2 expression levels in leaves.

steps.title: Analyze SUC2 expression
steps.instruction: Quantify SUC2 mRNA levels in leaves of grafted plants to determine the effect of root-derived CLE peptides.

steps.title: Prepare Neuronal Cultures
steps.instruction: Collect tissue specimens from mouse embryos (E15.5) in dissection media and culture them in neuronal complete medium on 12 mm coverslips in 24-well plates.

steps.title: Plate Neurons
steps.instruction: Plate high-density neuronal cultures at a density of 750–1000 cells/mm² and allow them to grow.

steps.title: Transduce Neurons
steps.instruction: Transduce primary neuronal cultures with GFP-expressing pLVTH virus at DIV4 at a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of 2.

steps.title: Treat Neurons
steps.instruction: Treat neurons with 10 ng/ml FGFb and 5 ng/ml EGF for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Perform MTT Assay
steps.instruction: Seed cortical cultures in a 96-well plate at 5 × 10³ cells/cm² and incubate for 24 hours at 37°C.

steps.title: Add MTT Solution
steps.instruction: Solubilize MTT in PBS at 5 mg/ml and add it to the cultures to achieve a final concentration of 0.25 mg/ml, then incubate for 2 hours at 37°C.

steps.title: Measure Absorbance
steps.instruction: Decant the medium, solubilize formazan precipitates in 200 μL of DMSO, and measure absorbance at 570 nm using a spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Wash Neurons
steps.instruction: Wash neurons in PBS to prepare for biochemical analysis.

steps.title: Lyse Neurons
steps.instruction: Lysis neurons in RIPA buffer and agitate gently for 1 hour at 4°C.

steps.title: Centrifuge Lysate
steps.instruction: Clarify the lysate by centrifugation at 16,000 g for 20 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Prepare Protein Samples
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration using the Bradford assay and dilute samples with Laemmli buffer for SDS-PAGE.

steps.title: Transfer Proteins
steps.instruction: Load protein samples onto 10% SDS-PAGE gels and transfer proteins to nitrocellulose membranes.

steps.title: Apply Primary Antibodies
steps.instruction: Incubate membranes with primary antibodies overnight in blocking buffer.

steps.title: Detect Proteins
steps.instruction: Use the ECL prime detection system to visualize proteins and acquire images using the ChemiDoc Touch imaging system.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Quantify protein bands using ImageLab software and log data for statistical analysis.
